bb32ba8f.title: MS Fabric Architect
bb32ba8f.description:
**MS Fabric Architect**

**Experience:** 10–15 Years  
**Work Location:** Remote  
**Shift Timing:** 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **MS Fabric Architect** with strong expertise in **Microsoft Fabric, Data Engineering, Lakehouse, Warehouse, pipeline architecture, and large\-scale data integration**. The ideal candidate will drive technical architecture, lead Data Engineering initiatives, and collaborate with customers and global architecture teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design enterprise\-grade **Microsoft Fabric data architectures** and partitioning strategies.
* Provide expert guidance on **Lakehouse vs. Warehouse** architecture and usage.
* Design and optimize **Data Engineering pipelines**, synchronization schedules, and workload execution based on **Fabric Capacity Unit (CU) utilization**.
* Architect and manage complex data extraction and ingestion processes from **1,000\+ databases** at scheduled intervals.
* Lead and guide Data Engineering teams on technical solutions, best practices, and delivery.
* Participate in customer\-facing discussions related to architecture, delivery, and technical solutions.
* Collaborate with other Architects and global teams to support enterprise\-wide deployments.
* Drive performance, scalability, reliability, and optimization of Microsoft Fabric solutions.

**Required Skills**

* 10–15 years of experience in **Data Engineering, Data Architecture, or related technologies**.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in **Microsoft Fabric**.
* Expert knowledge of **Lakehouse and Warehouse architecture**.
* Strong understanding of **data partitioning and pipeline design strategies**.
* Experience with **Fabric Capacity Units (CU), scheduling, and workload optimization**.
* Experience handling **large\-scale data integrations and complex data pulls**.
* Strong leadership and Data Engineering team management skills.
* Excellent customer\-facing and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working with global teams and enterprise deployments.

**Preferred Qualification**

* **Microsoft Fabric certification** is preferred.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and architectural decision\-making skills.
* Flexible to support **US EST overlap** as required.

Pay: ₹90,000\.00 \- ₹120,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* data engineering : 10 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

e7b1ac00.description:
Cloud Platform Engineer – Azure AI Foundry \| AI/LLM \| Python \| DevOps

**Experience:** 8–12 Years  
**Employment Type:** –C2C 6 Months (Extendable)  
**Work Location:** Hybrid – Bangalore \| Mumbai \| Pune \| Hyderabad  
**Work Mode:** 3 Days per Week from Office  
**Shift Timing:** 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST  
**US EST Overlap:** Candidate should be flexible for up to 4 hours of overlap with US EST hours

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Cloud Platform Engineer** with strong expertise in **Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, Generative AI, LLMs, Python, and DevOps**.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, deploying, and managing secure, scalable, and high\-performing cloud\-native AI solutions. The role requires hands\-on experience with **Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, RAG, AI Agents, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, cloud security, and monitoring**.

* Design, build, deploy, and manage cloud\-native AI solutions on Microsoft Azure.
* Develop and deploy AI applications using **Azure AI Foundry (Azure AI Studio)** and **Azure OpenAI Service**.

* Strong hands\-on experience with **Microsoft Azure and cloud\-native architectures**.

* Experience with **RAG, Vector Search, Semantic Search, AI Agents, and Prompt Flow**.

This is a **C2H opportunity for 6 months, extendable based on project requirements and performance**. Candidates with strong hands\-on experience in **Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Python, RAG, AI Agents, AKS, Terraform, and DevOps** are preferred.

062e56c1.title: Applied Solutions Architect, Google Cloud
062e56c1.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.
* Experience building full\-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 4 years of experience in software development, systems architecture, or a highly technical customer\-facing role with proficiency in one of more general\-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go).
* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Experience with cloud\-native application development.
* Experience designing and building AI applications.


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the technical bridge between our customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer the Proof of Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. By keeping the final production end\-state in mind from day one, you will advocate for our AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape. Design comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation. Code, build, and deploy robust cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions—such as agentic workflows, RAG systems, and applied foundation models—backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as\-is systems to demonstrate true business value. Ensure all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

3f36fd92.title: DevOps Architect
3f36fd92.description:
**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **DevOps Architect** 
 to drive the design, implementation, and management of scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have deep expertise in DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms, and infrastructure automation across multiple cloud environments along with strong leadership and mentoring capabilities.
 



**Job Duties And Responsibilities** 



* Lead and manage the DevOps team to ensure reliable infrastructure and automated deployment processes.
* Design, implement and maintain highly available, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure across at least two major cloud providers, such as AWS, Azure, GCP or Oracle.
* Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines for multiple applications and environments.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible.
* Oversee monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure system health and performance.
* Collaborate with Development, QA, and Security teams to integrate DevOps best practices across the SDLC.
* Lead incident management and root cause analysis for production issues.
* Ensure robust security practices for infrastructure and pipelines (secrets management, vulnerability scanning, etc.).
* Guide and mentor team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence.
* Evaluate, recommend, and implement Agentic DevOps automation solutions that autonomously improve operational efficiency, streamline workflows, reduce manual intervention, and optimize infrastructure and delivery processes.



**Required Qualifications Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field; Master's preferred



**Experience** 



* 12\+ years of relevant experience in DevOps, Infrastructure, or Cloud Operations.
* 5\+ years of experience in a technical leadership or team lead role.



**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** 



* Expertise in at least two major cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Strong experience in cloud cost optimization, usage forecasting, and resource planning across AWS/Azure environments.
* Experience deploying and scaling solutions via AWS Marketplace or Azure Marketplace, including pricing, billing, and operational considerations.
* Strong experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar.
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
* Proficient in containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Strong knowledge of monitoring, logging, and alerting tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch).
* Scripting knowledge in languages like Python, Bash, or Go.
* Solid understanding of networking, security, and system administration.
* Experience in implementing security best practices across DevOps pipelines.
* Proven ability to mentor, coach, and lead technical teams.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Ability to leverage Agentic DevOps automation frameworks to drive autonomous infrastructure provisioning, operational remediation, and continuous optimization of DevOps workflows.
* Experience with serverless architecture and microservices deployment.
* Experience with security tools and best practices (e.g., IAM, VPNs, firewalls, cloud security posture management).
* Exposure to hybrid cloud or multi\-cloud environments.
* Knowledge of cost optimization and cloud governance strategies.
* Experience working in Agile teams and managing infrastructure in production\-grade environments
* Relevant certifications (AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Expert, CKA, etc.).



**Working Conditions** 



* Work Arrangement: On\-site opportunity based out of our Trivandrum office.
* Travel Requirements: Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, user research, or conferences.
* On\-Call Requirements: Light on\-call rotation may be required depending on operational needs.
* Hours of Work: Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week, with overlap with PST required as needed.



**Living AOT s Values** 




**Role** 




 Our values guide how we work, collaborate, and grow as a team. Every role at AOT is expected to embody and promote these values:
 


* Innovation: We pursue true innovation by solving problems and meeting unarticulated needs.
* Integrity: We hold ourselves to high ethical standards and never compromise.
* Ownership: We are all responsible for our shared long\-term success.
* Agility: We stay ready to adapt to change and deliver results.
* Collaboration: We believe collaboration and knowledge\-sharing fuel innovation and success.
* Empowerment: We support our people so they can bring the best of themselves to work every day.

09aadc1b.title: Senior Consultant - Cloud Infra & AI
09aadc1b.description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solution \- Global Center for Innovation and Delivery (GCID) delivers end\-to\-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000\+ exceptional people, MS GCID presents a great opportunity for highly skilled services professionals to make a foray into consulting, solution development and delivery roles. The ideal consultant is passionate about technology, has breadth rather than specific product depth, and has the drive and courage to articulate and stand up for a great solution delivering true value for the client.
   

  

 As a Microsoft Sr consultant, you will deliver quality engagements with your expertise, either as an advisor, reviewer, contributor, or resource in high profile projects to ensure customer value. The ideal candidate must have the ability to combine their technical skills, creativity, and customer focus to deliver great solutions to the customers and ensure they get the best out of our technologies and solutions. Consulting Delivery professionals bring subject matter and solution expertise to architectural teams, customers, and partners. They apply deep technical and business knowledge to accelerate the adoption of Microsoft devices and services by ensuring strategic, architectural, and operational alignment to customer and partner
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* As a full Stack Infrastructure Consultant, design, build, and optimize endtoend cloud and onpremises infrastructure solutions, ensuring secure, scalable, and highperforming environments across the entire technology stack.
* Responsible for technical quality assurance, identification, and mitigation of technical risk across customer or partner deliverables delivery technology strategy aligned solutions
* Applies technical experience and industry\-specific knowledge to develop solutions, based on an analysis of how the proposed approach affects the business objectives of customers and partners.
* Applies information\-compliance and assurance policies to ensure stakeholder confidence.
* Identifies new processes and innovations to help customers or partners build and accelerate capabilities by using Microsoft technologies.
* Identifies the best practice approach for a project, across a wide scope of technical issues, and develops or reuses intellectual capital with customers, world\-wide, and for programs and initiatives across Microsoft.
* Defines engagements and opportunities to use Intellectual Property (IP) and address product gaps, while leveraging existing IP and community resources to ensure consistency and improve predictability.


**Qualifications**
* 9\-13 years of industry experience with a minimum of 9\+ years of Azure Infrastructure experience
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience; advanced technical certifications or higher education preferred.
* Mandatory Microsoft Azure Administrator certification (AZ104\); Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ305\) highly preferred.
* Terraform Associate certification strongly valued, with proven experience in InfrastructureasCode (IaC) automation.
* Cloud AI certification such as Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI‑900\) or equivalent is a strong advantage, with practical understanding of AI/ML workloads on cloud platforms.
* Experience across both application architecture and cloud infrastructure domains, with the ability to bridge development and operations teams effectively.


 AI First Infrastructure Skills
   

  

* Proficiency in Python for automation, AI integration, and scripting across infra workflows
* Experience with Azure AI Services (AI Foundry, AI Agent services, Azure AI Search, Vision, Speech, Translation,) leveraged as infrastructure components for applications
* Understanding of containerized AI workloads with strong hands\-on expertise in AI Developer Tools from Microsoft\- Visual Studio, GitHub Copilot, Azure AI Studio, Azure AI Foundry or similar third\-party
* Ability to integrate OpenAI/Frontier models into cloud environments with secure and scalable infrastructure patterns (from applied AI delivery examples)


 Azure Cloud Strategy, Networking and Devops
   

  

 Cloud Strategy \& Architecture
   

  

* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft’s Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF).
* Proven experience in designing, implementing, and deploying Azure Landing Zones.


 Landing Zone and Networking
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with Azure IaaS and PaaS services across compute, storage, and networking.
* Expertise in deploying business mission\-critical applications on Azure.
* In\-depth knowledge of Azure networking components including VNet, ExpressRoute, vWAN, ingress/egress patterns, and Network Virtual Appliances (NVAs)


 DevOps \& Automation
   

  

* Proficiency in Azure DevOps, including YAML\-based pipeline configuration.
* Experience with at least one CI/CD platform: GitHub, GitLab, or Jenkins (working knowledge of others is a plus).
* Strong automation skills using ARM templates, Bicep, Terraform, PowerShell, and Azure CLI.
* Experience deploying infrastructure using a modular, reusable approach.


 Multi Cloud Migration \& Modernization
   

  

* Multi\-Cloud Migration experience. Hands\-on experience in AWS or GCP to Azure migration.
* Experience with large\-scale cloud migration projects using tools like Azure Migrate.
* Familiarity with all stages of the migration lifecycle, including assessment, planning, execution, and optimization.
* Experience with container migration and modernization initiatives.


 Infrastructure Security and Zero Trust Practices
   

  

* Strong command of network segmentation, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Private Link, VPN/ExpressRoute security, and Zero Trust networking.
* Implement secure connectivity and encrypted network flows across hybrid and cloud environments.
* Implement Azure Policy, Blueprints, governance guardrails, and secure by design patterns.
* Experience in meeting compliance standards and performing cloud security assessments.
* Deploy secure landing zones following CAF \& WAF (Cloud Adoption Framework \& Well‑Architected Framework) principles ensuring governance, resiliency, and secure adoption paths
* Ensuring alignment with industry frameworks like Zero Trust principles


 Consulting \& Delivery Mindset
   

  

* Strong interest in continuous learning and technical certifications
* Curiosity to explore emerging data and AI technologies
* Willingness to receive feedback, grow technical depth, and expand ownership over time
* Demonstrated success in delivering customer\-facing projects in large\-scale enterprise environments
* Experience conducting technical workshops, envisioning sessions, and solution design engagements.
* Exposure to multiple industries and sectors, with the ability to tailor solutions to diverse business needs.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Passion for mentoring, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
* Proven adaptability to new technologies and evolving customer requirements.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.


 Embody our culture and values
   

  

 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
 **requesting accommodations.**

dc310e20.title: AWS Cloud Engineer with Gen AI
dc310e20.description:
**Role Description**
**Position Overview**
 We are looking for a highly skilled
 **Infrastructure Engineer** 
 with strong expertise in
 **AWS Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Security, and Infrastructure Automation** 
 . The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and optimizing highly available, scalable, and cloud\-native infrastructure on AWS.
   

  

 This role will play a key part in building secure enterprise platforms supporting modern cloud applications, containerized workloads, and next\-generation
 **AI/GenAI services** 
 powered by
 **Amazon Bedrock** 
 and
 **AWS AgentCore** 
 . You will collaborate closely with Platform Engineering, DevOps, Security, Architecture, and Application teams to deliver resilient, compliant, and automated cloud environments aligned with enterprise standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**1\. AWS Cloud Infrastructure \& Networking** 
  

  

* Design, implement, and manage scalable AWS infrastructure following Well\-Architected Framework best practices.
* Configure and maintain AWS networking services including:
+ Amazon VPC
+ Public \& Private Subnets
+ Route Tables
+ Security Groups
+ Network ACLs
+ Internet Gateway
+ NAT Gateway
+ AWS Transit Gateway
+ VPC Endpoints / AWS PrivateLink
+ Amazon Route 53
+ Application \& Network Load Balancers (ALB/NLB)
+ AWS WAF
+ Amazon CloudFront

* Build highly available, fault\-tolerant, and disaster recovery\-ready cloud environments.
* Optimize network performance, security, and connectivity across multi\-account AWS environments.


* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) \& Automation
* Develop reusable Infrastructure\-as\-Code modules using:
+ Terraform
+ AWS CDK
+ AWS CloudFormation

* Automate infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management.
* Implement infrastructure versioning, modularization, and reusable deployment patterns.
* Enforce governance through Policy\-as\-Code and automated compliance validation.
* Platform Engineering \& Container Services
* Deploy and manage cloud\-native applications using:
+ Kubernetes
+ Amazon EKS
+ Amazon ECS/Fargate
+ Docker

* Build scalable and secure container platforms.
* Support application modernization initiatives and cloud\-native platform adoption.
* Improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* AI / GenAI Infrastructure
* Provision and manage secure infrastructure supporting:
+ Amazon Bedrock
+ AWS AgentCore

* Design secure networking and access controls for AI workloads.
* Implement monitoring, logging, and operational controls for AI platform services.
* Collaborate with AI engineering teams to deliver scalable GenAI infrastructure.
* Cloud Security \& Compliance
* Design and implement AWS cloud security best practices.
* Configure and manage:
+ AWS IAM
+ AWS KMS
+ AWS Secrets Manager

* Implement enterprise\-grade security controls including:
+ Mutual TLS (mTLS)
+ OAuth 2\.0 / OpenID Connect (OIDC)
+ API Security
+ Rate Limiting
+ PHI Data Protection \& Tokenization

* Ensure cloud infrastructure complies with organizational security standards and regulatory requirements.
* Observability \& Reliability Engineering
* Implement enterprise observability using:
+ Amazon CloudWatch
+ OpenTelemetry

* Develop dashboards, s, and operational runbooks.
* Perform production troubleshooting, root cause analysis (RCA), and incident remediation.
* Improve platform reliability through proactive monitoring and automation.
* FinOps \& Cloud Cost Optimization
* Monitor cloud resource utilization and infrastructure spend.
* Recommend and implement cost optimization strategies.
* Support cloud budgeting, forecasting, and governance initiatives.
* Optimize compute, storage, networking, and managed service costs without compromising performance.
* DevOps \& Collaboration
* Maintain Infrastructure\-as\-Code repositories using Git/GitHub.
* Integrate infrastructure deployments into CI/CD pipelines.
* Collaborate with Security, DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, and Application teams to deliver secure and automated cloud solutions.
* Promote DevSecOps best practices across engineering teams.


**Required Technical Skills**
**AWS Cloud Services**
* Amazon VPC
* Route 53
* Transit Gateway
* AWS PrivateLink
* ALB / NLB
* AWS WAF
* CloudFront
* IAM
* AWS KMS
* AWS Secrets Manager
* Amazon Bedrock
* AWS AgentCore


**Infrastructure as Code**
* Terraform
* AWS CDK
* AWS CloudFormation


**Containers \& Platform Engineering**
* Kubernetes
* Amazon EKS
* Amazon ECS/Fargate
* Docker


**Monitoring \& Observability**
* Amazon CloudWatch
* OpenTelemetry


**Security**
* IAM
* mTLS
* OAuth 2\.0 / OIDC
* API Security
* Rate Limiting
* PHI Tokenization
* Encryption \& Key Management


**DevOps**
* Git
* GitHub
* CI/CD Pipelines

5694bdd5.title: Technical Solutions Architect
5694bdd5.description:
**Company Overview**
 Leading with our core values of Quality, Integrity, and Opportunity, MedInsight is one of the healthcare industry’s most trusted solutions for healthcare intelligence. Our company’s purpose is to empower easy, data\-driven decision\-making on important healthcare questions. MedInsight products, education, and services make an impact on healthcare by helping to drive better outcomes for patients while reducing wasteful services. Over 300 leading healthcare organizations have come to rely on MedInsight analytic solutions for healthcare cost and care management.
   

  

 MedInsight is a subsidiary of Milliman; a global, employee\-owned consultancy providing actuarial consulting, retirement funding and healthcare financing, enterprise risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics, and business transformation, as well as a range of other consulting and technology solutions.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The MedInsight Strategic Analytics Services team is looking for a Technical Solutions Architect (Cloud Engineer) to support a variety of healthcare analytics, predictive analytics, and digital transformation projects, leveraging a variety of data types. As a member of the technical staff and a trusted advisor to clients, this professional will join our team to assist in all phases of technical consulting work, including requirements gathering, scalable solution design, data architectures, research, and development. The successful candidate will have strong analytic, technical, and communication skills, and the ability to partner in the delivery of business value to diverse organizations, manage multiple simultaneous projects and innovate solutions that leverage a cloud\-first environment.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Work both independently and in a cross\-functional team environment.
* Listen to, understand, and break client questions down into manageable tasks.
* Be comfortable in presenting and discussing ideas with senior leaders of client organizations and Milliman MedInsight.
* Understand client business goals and strategic context and harvest requirements from client organizations.
* Work independently on assigned tasks, i.e., plan, organize, delegate, problem solve, and meet established deadlines.
* Develop senior technical staff through involvement with effectively aligned cross\-functional teams.
* Prioritize work under time pressure. Follow\-through and exceptional attention to detail on all project tasks are essential.
* Use a variety of proprietary products and technologies to answer simple and complex client questions.
* Turn data results into client\-facing deliverables that are informative and easy\-to\-use.
* Standardize ad hoc processes and drive continuous improvement for automating and optimizing performance of ongoing processes.
* Assist senior technical staff with the support of, upgrades of, and modifications to, existing advanced data products.
* Ensure clear and comprehensive documentation of analytic methodologies and new technical approaches.
* Represent MedInsight at client meetings and trainings.


**Basic Qualifications**
 Minimum 8 to 10 years of relevant work experience. Preference will be given to candidates with healthcare data experience and cloud solutions experience. Previous experience working with large healthcare claims and/or EHR databases preferred.
   

  

**General**
* Working knowledge of healthcare concepts and data structures.
* Familiarity with healthcare claims data and data analytic platforms.
* Ability to prioritize and manage concurrent projects.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Execute work with exceptional attention to detail on all project tasks.
* Ability to work independently and within a diverse team environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks with little supervision and work under time pressure.
* Client consulting experience.


**Technical**
* Programming/development experience with Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Python.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages (Spark, SQL, Python, R, C\#) preferred.
* Experience in managing or guiding organizations’ transitions from on\-premise to cloud resources.
* Data warehousing and/or large IT project experience.
* Understanding of OLAP technologies.
* Experience working with large data sets.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft Excel.
* Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite of products.
* Healthcare informatics, analytics, and reporting knowledge.


**Educational Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in statistics, mathematics, computer science, information systems, finance, economics, engineering, or related fields.


**Desired Experience And Traits**
* Experience working with relational and big data database technologies (Databricks, Microsoft Azure). Experience collapsing, joining, merging data sets.
* Hands\-on experience in creating microservices architecture and cloud\-native applications.
* Hands\-on experience in Agile design and implementation approaches.
* Experience in reducing costs and improving efficiencies in data analytics.
* Healthcare claims analysis experience a plus.
* Ability to translate complex healthcare data questions from clients or account managers into manageable tasks.
* Self\-motivated, organized, and adaptable – adept at planning and execution, capable of prioritizing and accomplishing goals across a spectrum of concurrent tasks for varying stakeholders.
* Consultative and confident approach: Critical thinker, able to effectively comprehend complex business issues and develop solutions and communications that work for varying stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented: Recognizes that the small things make all the difference and pays attention to everything.
* Collaborative: Demonstrated ability to work with engineering and analytics teams to discuss technical concepts, make tradeoffs and evaluate new ideas.
* Intellectually curious: Desire and ability to learn new skills, systems, and processes, and interest in exploring data credibility and advanced analytic approaches.
* Energetic, optimistic, and hard\-working: Maintains a can\-do attitude and is unrelenting in the pursuit of excellence.


 Above all else, we are looking for someone who is excited about working in a fast\-paced environment, collaborating with individuals across multiple teams to solve problems, and developing data\-driven solutions that make important information easy to access, understand and act upon.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is an innovative self\-starter with solid technical foundations, who is interested in working with our team of experienced professionals to make a measurable impact on the business challenges faced by healthcare organizations today. The Milliman MedInsight group has been rapidly growing within different segments of the healthcare field, with presence amongst payers, employers, providers, accountable care organizations, pharmacy benefit managers, digital health companies, and other types of organizations. Successful candidates will support a variety of custom analytic client engagements and will also have opportunities to develop within their position and grow within the larger team.
   

  

**What makes this a great opportunity?**
* Join an award\-winning firm with a track record of growth backed by a marketplace powerhouse.
* Be part of the expansion and evolution of an analytics, technology, and research team in a data\-driven company.
* Enjoy significant visibility and be recognized for your wins.
* Work with a tenured collaborative team that values diversification of thought and new ideas.
* Grow and develop your skills and experience in an organization that invests energy in your career trajectory every day.
* Accelerate data interoperability, advanced analytics, and optimal use of cloud technologies.
* Help client and partner organizations improve healthcare for populations and communities.

1abbe56c.description:
**Role Summary**




 Mitra is looking for a
 **Senior Technical Service Manager – Infrastructure \& Cloud** 
 to lead the operational management of a strategic US enterprise customer's hybrid infrastructure environment.
 



 The role is responsible for the day\-to\-day management, service delivery, and technical governance of a large infrastructure estate comprising
 **200\+ on\-premises servers** 
 , while supporting the customer's transition to AWS. The successful candidate will own the infrastructure service end\-to\-end—ensuring operational stability, SLA compliance, incident management, and customer satisfaction across both on\-premises and cloud environments.
 



 This is
 **not a migration delivery role** 
 . Instead, the Technical Service Manager will facilitate and govern the transition, working closely with infrastructure engineers and cloud architects while taking full ownership of the operational service before, during, and after migration. As workloads move to AWS, the role will evolve to manage both the remaining on\-premises infrastructure and the newly established cloud environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**



* Own the day\-to\-day delivery of managed infrastructure services across on\-premises and AWS environments.
* Act as the primary technical and operational contact for the client, managing stakeholder relationships and service governance.
* Ensure infrastructure availability, performance, security, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and SLA compliance.
* Coordinate infrastructure support teams, cloud engineers, and third\-party vendors to deliver high\-quality managed services.
* Facilitate the client's on\-premises to AWS transition by ensuring operational readiness, service continuity, and successful handover into managed operations.
* Lead ITIL\-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Major Incident Management processes.
* Drive continuous service improvement, automation, operational efficiency, and infrastructure best practices.
* Mentor technical teams and provide leadership on complex infrastructure and operational issues.



  





**Requirements**



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **10\+ years** 
 of experience in Infrastructure Operations, Technical Service Management, or Managed Services.
* Proven experience managing and supporting
 **enterprise on\-premises infrastructure** 
 , including Windows/Linux servers, VMware, Active Directory, networking, storage, backup, and disaster recovery.
* Hands\-on experience managing
 **AWS infrastructure and cloud operations** 
 , with a solid understanding of core AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Systems Manager, and AWS Backup.
* Experience supporting
 **hybrid infrastructure environments** 
 , with responsibility for both on\-premises and cloud platforms.
* Exposure to infrastructure modernization or cloud migration programmes, with the ability to ensure operational readiness and seamless transition into managed services.
* Strong understanding of ITIL Service Management processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Major Incident Management.
* Experience using enterprise ITSM and monitoring platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Datadog, SolarWinds, Splunk, or similar tools.
* Excellent client\-facing communication, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.
* Proven ability to lead infrastructure support teams and coordinate cross\-functional technical resources.



  





**Preferred Certifications**



* **AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate** 
 or
 **AWS SysOps Administrator – Associate** 
 (highly desirable).
* **AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional** 
 (an added advantage).
* **ITIL v4 Foundation** 
 or higher.
* Microsoft Azure Administrator, Windows Server Hybrid Administrator, VMware VCP, or PMP certifications will be considered an advantage.

 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 In this role, you will drive the end\-to\-end planning, tracking, and execution of complex ML storage infrastructure programs (including Napa priorities like materialization, pushing, and sovereignty/compliance). You will serve as the structural bridge between the centralized Napa team and the horizontal File Formats (Artus) team to prevent technical silos, manage cross\-team dependencies, and ensure frictionless integration. Exercise strong technical judgment to translate high\-level business requirements and architectural recommendations into actionable engineering roadmaps; proactively identify and mitigate systemic risks stemming from platform shifts and infrastructure shortages. You will design, implement, and optimize lightweight project management processes, tracking frameworks and dashboard solutions to help a rapidly evolving site organization scale efficiently. You will navigate ambiguous environments and rapidly resolve cross\-functional or inter\-team dependencies to preserve timeline velocity on business\-critical client commitments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Review key metrics pertaining to a program, monitor potential metric deviations, and define corrective actions for critical deviations.

 We're a global, multi\-disciplinary team that's transforming the future of mobility through innovative automotive technologies. At HARMAN Automotive, you'll have the opportunity to lead complex connectivity programs, collaborate with global customers, and drive the delivery of next\-generation connected vehicle solutions.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Connectivity Program Manager** 
 to lead automotive connectivity programs from India. The role requires strong program management, customer\-facing experience, stakeholder management, and technical understanding of connected vehicle technologies. You will be responsible for end\-to\-end program execution, delivery management, resource planning, and customer satisfaction while working with global engineering teams.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of automotive connectivity programs.
* Act as the primary customer interface for program execution, delivery, and escalations.
* Define project scope, timelines, milestones, and delivery plans.
* Manage program schedules, budgets, risks, dependencies, and issue resolution.

* Drive customer discussions, project reviews, and executive status meetings.

* Drive continuous process improvements and ensure compliance with organizational standards.


 What Makes You Eligible
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (BE/B.Tech) or equivalent.
* 10\+ years of experience in automotive software development, with at least 5 years in Program or Project Management.
* Strong experience managing automotive Connectivity, Telematics, or Infotainment programs.
* Experience working with global OEM customers and cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Agile, and Waterfall methodologies.
* Proven experience in customer management, stakeholder management, and executive communication.

ce740716.title: Engineering Delivery Lead
ce740716.description:
**Job Description:** 




 We are seeking an experienced Engineering Delivery Lead to drive the successful execution of large\-scale data and technology programs. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and solving complex business and delivery challenges, owning the data and product roadmap, and ensuring seamless execution across teams. You will provide strong operational and program leadership while working closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the identification and definition of complex business challenges, whether they arise from delivery challenges (resource bottlenecks, technical obstacles) or customer\-side issues (usability, satisfaction). Break down these challenges into smaller, manageable components and align teams toward clear goals and outcomes.
* Develop and maintain the program roadmap, aligning it with organizational goals. Adjust and adapt the roadmap based on changing business priorities, feedback from stakeholders, or unforeseen challenges.
* Develop a deep understanding of the program's value to customers and clients. Ensure we addresses customer pain points and drives business growth. Ensure that features and updates meet customer expectations.
* Oversee the execution of operational processes, ensuring all teams are aligned and accountable for meeting program objectives. Track progress and continually optimize workflows to enhance productivity and performance.
* Actively manage relationships with key stakeholders, including development teams, designers, marketing, sales, customer support, and leadership.
* Facilitate clear and effective communication across teams to ensure alignment on goals and progress.
* Articulate complex business problems, product strategies, and program progress to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders in a clear, concise, and compelling manner. Provide regular updates on program status, roadblocks, and solutions.
* Proactively seek opportunities to improve the Program and processes, drawing from customer feedback, performance metrics, and lessons learned. Drive ongoing optimization efforts to enhance program performance and user experience.



  





**Required Skills and Experience:** 



* 10 \- 14 years of overall work experience, with 7\+ years of experience in Program and Project Management.
* Proficiency in using tools such as JIRA to manage tasks, track progress, and report on project status.
* Strong understanding of SQL for querying databases and analyzing data.
* Familiarity with the technical aspects of data product development, including architecture and cloud infrastructure, to effectively communicate with development teams.
* Experience in building data processing applications using Hadoop, Spark, and NoSQL databases.
* Experience in building scalable enterprise data warehousing and modelling on\-prem and/or on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
* Experience in managing and executing large programs; ability to act as an Agile coach to teams and customers.
* Experience in managing multiple teams and scaling them.
* Ability to identify and analyze complex business challenges (technical, operational, or client\-related) and break them into smaller, manageable problems, support proposal creation and pre\-sales activities.
* Experience in creating and maintaining data and product roadmaps, adjusting them based on changing priorities, feedback, and unforeseen challenges (risk and change management, risk mitigation).
* Ability to build strong relationships with multiple stakeholders, including developers, designers, marketing, sales, and leadership teams.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Operational leadership experience in overseeing the execution of operational processes and improving workflows for maximum efficiency.



  





**Business \& Client Leadership:** 



* Develop a strong understanding of client business processes, domain priorities, and strategic objectives to ensure engineering initiatives are aligned with measurable business outcomes.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to translate business challenges into scalable technology solutions and delivery roadmaps.



  





**Account Growth \& Stakeholder Management:** 



* Build and nurture relationships with key client stakeholders, proactively identifying opportunities for account expansion, renewals, and cross\-functional engagement.
* Support account growth initiatives by leveraging delivery success, identifying whitespace opportunities, and collaborating with account and sales teams.



  





**Organizational Contribution:** 



* Contribute to organizational growth through capability building, mentoring, hiring, thought leadership, and driving engineering excellence initiatives across the practice.



  





**Being a Mathemagician:** 



* Embody MathCo’s culture and way of working.
* Demonstrate ownership and strive for excellence in delivering results.
* Actively engage and contribute to initiatives fostering company growth.
* Support diversity and appreciate different perspectives.



  





**Recognitions:** 



* Positioned as a Leader in Top Generative AI Service Providers – PeMa Quadrant 2023 by AIMResearch.
* Recognized among Inspiring Workplaces in North America, 2023\.
* Accredited for Inclusive Practices by Great Place to Work Institute, India.
* Recognized among India’s Best Workplaces™ for Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging 2023 by Great Place To Work® India.



  





 For more information, please visit our website:
 
 www.mathco.com

**Role Overview:**





**Senior Manager \- Pre\-Sales \& Bid Management** 
 – will play a strategic role in supporting the leadership team in interpreting complex tenders, translating technical requirements into actionable business insights and driving the end\-to\-end bid management process.
 



  
 



 The role requires a strong blend of technical acumen, commercial understanding, proposal writing expertise, and cross\-functional collaboration to maximize the organization's success rate in competitive bidding.
 



  





**Key Responsibility Areas**
**:** 




  
 



**1\. Bid and Tender Management** 









 · Identify, monitor, and evaluate bid opportunities across Broadcast Services, Sports Broadcasting, Media Technology, Systems Integration, Private and Public Undertaking, Sports Federations and Broadcasters.
 



 · Establish and manage subscriptions to relevant tender intelligence platforms, procurement portals, industry databases, and market intelligence agencies to ensure comprehensive coverage of bidding opportunities.
 



 · Track opportunities published through GeM, CPP Portal, Ministry portals, Sports Authorities, Broadcasters, and other public and private procurement channels.
 



 · Maintain a structured bid pipeline and provide leadership with regular updates on upcoming tenders, market trends, and strategic opportunities.
 



  
 



**2\. Technical Interpretation \& Bid Strategy** 




 · Analyze tender documents, technical specifications, compliance matrices, eligibility criteria, commercial conditions, and contractual obligations.
 



 · Translate complex technical requirements into simplified business insights, enabling leadership to make informed bid/no\-bid and investment decisions.
 



 · Break down customer requirements into technical, commercial, operational, and compliance workstreams and coordinate internal stakeholders accordingly.
 



 · Maintain and continuously enhance a centralized repository of technical content, proposal templates, case studies, certifications, compliance documents, and best practices.
 



  
 



**3\. Techno\-Commercial Evaluation** 




 · Conduct detailed technical, commercial, contractual, and risk assessments of tender documents.
 



 · Identify bid risks, deviations, assumptions, and contractual obligations, and recommend mitigation strategies to leadership.
 



 · Collaborate with Engineering, Broadcast Operations, System Integration, Finance, Procurement, Legal, OEMs, and Delivery teams to develop technically robust and commercially competitive solutions.
 



  
 



**4\. Stakeholder Management \& Compliance** 




 · Develop strong working relationships with Government departments, broadcasters, sports bodies, consultants, OEMs, technology partners, and key stakeholders to strengthen the Company's market positioning.
 



 · Work closely with the Leadership Team to provide technical and commercial clarity on strategic opportunities and support bid qualification decisions.
 



 · Track procurement trends, technology advancements, competitor positioning, and industry developments within the Broadcast, Sports Tech, Media, and System Integration sectors.
 



 · Ensure complete compliance with customer specifications, tender conditions, statutory requirements, and procurement regulations.
 



  





**Ideal candidate will have
 
 :** 




 ·      Bachelor's degree in engineering (Electrical \& Electronics Engineering, Electronics \& Communication Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, or equivalent).
 



 ·   A Management Degree (MBA/PGDM) will be an added advantage.
 



 · \~10 years of experience in Pre\-Sales, Bid Management, Proposal Management, or Techno\-Commercial functions within Broadcast, Media Technology, Sports Broadcasting, System Integration, ICT, or Government projects.
 



 · \~ 2 years of working in mid\-management level position in any respected Systems Integration or High\-tech company dealing in multi\-million\-dollar RFPs
 



 · Experience using tender intelligence platforms and market research tools to identify and track new business opportunities.
 



  
 



**Who should apply?**




 Ideal for detail\-oriented individuals who thrive in cross\-functional environments and have delivered mission\-critical solutions across Government, Defense, Public sector, Sports, Media and Enterprise sector.

**Role Description**
 Position Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a highly accomplished
 **Technology Principal** 
 to join Our Solution Engineering and Architecture Leadership organization. This senior individual contributor role serves as the primary technical authority for strategic enterprise engagements across global verticals. The role is responsible for translating complex business challenges into differentiated, outcome\-driven solutions spanning
 **Agentic AI** 
 ,

 , Cloud, DevOps, and platform engineering.

This individual will play a critical role in shaping strategic deals, driving technical credibility, and positioning UST as a leader in AI\-powered engineering transformation.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead technical discovery, solution architecture, and validation for complex enterprise opportunities across Cloud, DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, and Agentic AI.
* Design and deliver compelling executive\-level architecture presentations, workshops, live demonstrations, and proof\-of\-concept engagements showcasing AI\-Native SDLC and Agentic AI capabilities.
* Partner closely with account teams and business stakeholders to define win strategies, shape RFP/RFI responses, and develop differentiated technical narratives for strategic pursuits.
* Architect end\-to\-end Agentic AI solutions including LLM integration, RAG pipelines, vector search, multi\-agent orchestration, enterprise workflow integration, and governance frameworks.
* Advise customers on AI\-Native SDLC transformation initiatives, including AI\-assisted development, developer experience modernization, CI/CD optimization, observability, and intelligent delivery automation.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to CxO, VP, and senior engineering audiences, articulating business value alongside architectural depth.
* Represent UST as a technical thought leader at customer briefings, executive forums, industry conferences, and partner engagements across the region.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic customer stakeholders, partners, hyperscalers, and ecosystem collaborators.
* Continuously evaluate emerging trends across AI, Agentic frameworks, foundation models, developer tooling, governance, and enterprise adoption patterns, translating them into actionable customer insights.
* Mentor and coach members of the SEALS organization, contributing to capability development, reusable assets, and architectural best practices.
* Collaborate with internal product, engineering, and innovation teams to channel customer feedback into roadmap and solution evolution.


 Required Qualifications
   

  

* 14–18 years of overall technology experience, including at least 5 years in pre\-sales, solution engineering, enterprise architecture, or technical advisory roles.
* Proven hands\-on experience designing and delivering enterprise\-grade Cloud, DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering solutions, with strong exposure to production\-scale Agentic AI or LLM\-powered systems.
* Strong foundation in software engineering excellence and modern architecture practices, including Well\-Architected Frameworks, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), observability, reliability engineering, and secure\-by\-design principles.
* Demonstrated success supporting and closing strategic enterprise engagements valued at $1M\+.
* Deep experience with one or more hyperscaler ecosystems: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including containerized and cloud\-native deployment patterns.
* Strong understanding of AI\-Native SDLC practices, including AI\-assisted coding, developer productivity tooling, CI/CD modernization, and intelligent software delivery workflows.
* Hands\-on proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, with the ability to develop, review, and demonstrate production\-quality code in customer\-facing scenarios.
* Strong knowledge of LLM architectures, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, vector databases, model evaluation, and multi\-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent ecosystems.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively with both executive and deeply technical audiences, influencing decisions through clarity, credibility, and business alignment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.


 Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Active participation in the AI and developer community through speaking engagements, technical publishing, open\-source contributions, or thought leadership initiatives.
* Experience in a Big 4 consulting firm, global systems integrator, or enterprise product organization with exposure to India, GCC, or global regional markets.
* Familiarity with Responsible AI principles, AI governance frameworks, and emerging regulatory standards such as the EU AI Act and India DPDP.
* Experience with AI benchmarking, evaluation frameworks, model selection strategies, and enterprise AI adoption methodologies.
* Relevant cloud and AI certifications such as AWS ML Specialty, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or Google Professional ML Engineer.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Exceptional consultative and problem\-framing skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into strategic technical solutions.
* Strong executive storytelling and communication capabilities, simplifying complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes and transformation narratives.
* Commercially astute and composed under pressure, with the ability to navigate complex, competitive, multi\-stakeholder enterprise sales environments.
* Naturally curious and innovation\-driven, with a passion for experimenting with emerging AI technologies and engineering practices.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration and influencing skills, capable of driving alignment without direct organizational authority.
* Team\-oriented mindset with a genuine commitment to mentoring, capability building, and knowledge sharing.


**Skills**
 Solution Architecture, Presales, Agentic AI, AWS, Azure, GCP, SRE, DevOps.

aa661ce5.description:
**About Anthropic**
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
   

  

**Location \- Mumbai**
**About The Role**
 As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre\-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia\-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer\-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
   

  

 Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams \& stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering \& development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market


**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical customer\-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C\-suite executives, engineering \& IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross\-organizational collaboration, working through trade\-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross\-organizational collaboration, working through trade\-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team


**Logistics**
**Minimum education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
   

  

**Required field of study:** 
 A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
   

  

**Minimum years of experience:** 
 Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
   

  

**Location\-based hybrid policy:** 
 Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
   

  

**Visa sponsorship:** 
 We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
   

  

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** 
 Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
   

  

**Your safety matters to us.** 
 To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
   

  

**How We're Different**
 We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
   

  

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
   

  

**Come work with us!**
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
 **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** 
 Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
