6c3d17c3.title: Solution Architect Manager
6c3d17c3.description:
**Overview**  

Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.

 **Responsibilities**  

People Management  



  

Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.

  

Model \- Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.

  

Coach \- Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.

  

Care \- Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

  

Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment

  

Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business goals. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.

  

Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.

  

Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.

  

Architecture Design and Deployment

  

Holds teams accountable for leveraging existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft's agreed commitments to the customer/partner and developing new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners and markets. When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.

  

Guides team in defining and documenting the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix. Ensures team is equipped to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Guides team in cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Promotes a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. Provides coaching to allow architects to scale solutions. Support new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft, as needed.

  

Collaborates with the other managers to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.

  

Guides team in working with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Supports team in managing and resolving complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Ensures maintenance of the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the Architecture of the business solution. Oversees development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer.

  

Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Ensures team builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex solution approach. Provides thought leadership on oversight and governance sets expectations for quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Promotes a cohesive build methodology so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams. When appropriate, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes. Challenges deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on regular cadence, as needed. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. Innovates and implements long\-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio, as needed. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.

  

Creates a culture and clarity around technical insights and escalations, and ensures broad sets of projects move forward. Provides support and guidance to team in identifying scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Resolves escalations as needed and coaches team on best practices for handling escalations. Ensures that issues and blockers and addressed by the appropriate groups. Identifies patterns in blockers across business areas or a territory. When necessary, attends steering committee meetings with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.  



  

Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary.

  

Practice Development

  

Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities.

  

Trusted Advisor

  

Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.

  

Coaches team to use evidence\-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed and guides team in doing so.

  

Provides their team with a holistic perspective of customer/partner challenges, industry trends, and competitor architectures to allow team members to engage with customers/partners, demonstrate Microsoft's value, and develop counter strategy.

  

Thought Leadership

  

Fosters community sharing of stories and leveraging of pre\-existing resources by encouraging and empowering team to share learnings and by establishing a cadence (e.g., internal technical brainstorming calls, presenting latest challenges in staff meetings) to calibrate on challenges and trends that impact the team across the subsidiary level. Holds teams accountable for sharing insights with v\-team members to inform the direction they take with customers/partners.

  

Participates in external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons) and shares learnings with internal team. Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Demonstrates deep industry knowledge and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences.

  

Other

  

Embody our culture and values

 **Qualifications**  

Required/Minimum Qualifications

  

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

  

OR master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 6\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

  

OR equivalent experience.

  

Additional or Preferred Qualifications

  

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 12\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

  

OR master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

  

OR equivalent experience.

  

6\+ years technical sales experience.

  

6\+ years project management experience.  



  

2\+ years managing multiple projects or portfolios.

  

1\+ year(s) experience leading blended, multidisciplinary teams.

  

3\+ years people management experience, including managing consultant practice managers, technical sales managers, and/or technical architect managers.

  

Technical or Professional Certification in Domain (e.g., Security).

  

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

  

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

980557f8.title: Release Delivery Lead
980557f8.description:
**About the Company** 
 : Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally. Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self\-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting. At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 : We are looking for Release Delivery Lead profile who ensures that the SAP system remains robust, secure, and aligned with business objectives while facilitating smooth system evolutions with releases and minimizing disruptions during changes.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 
 :
 


* Lead SAP Change Advisory Boards (CAB) and Cross\-Digital CAB ensuring change controls adherence and improvement of the release framework.
* Coordinate release windows and annual calendar with business units, IT teams, and infrastructure teams to minimize operational disruption.
* Define, maintain and communicate SAP release calendar across landscape.
* Manage transport requests and ensure proper sequencing across SAP system landscapes.
* Act as Release Delivery Manager to bring package of functionalities from scoping to delivery communicating with stakeholders, identifying risks and addressing them until resolution.
* Continuous improvement of Release management ways of working from ideation to adoption, end to end without disruptions in the operation, and in cooperation with AMS, SAP experts and other stakeholders.
* Ensure the sustain, evolution and governance of Release supporting toolset such as Solution Manager, JIRA, Confluence with strong emphasis in innovation and adoption of emerging technologies such AI and automation.
* Establish and maintain the right level of governance, leading the Global Release meeting, conducting quality gates, milestone reviews and Business Go/No\-Go reviews. Proactively report any releases risks and come with necessary mitigation plans.
* Communicate with stakeholders to identify any issues or risks that may affect the release schedule or quality of the ERP platform.
* Ensure the release notes are always set up and communicated with digital and business stakeholders as a part of release management process.
* Perform post\-release analysis to identify any issues that occurred during the release process and develop plans to prevent similar problems in future releases.
* Organize recurrent alignment with major rollouts and live country projects (sharing changes to methodology, outages, etc..).



  





**Qualifications** 
 :
 


* 8\+ years work experience as ERP Release Manager in complex landscape, preferably in a FMCG and/or FMCH context.
* Contributed in the design and adoption of retrofit, freeze and downtime strategies.
* Experience in Focused Build or SAP Cloud ALM is a plus.
* Solid experience in SAP release management, with a deep understanding of SAP S4HANA architecture and its modules, integrated systems and with technical knowledge to handle technical dependencies and conflicts.
* Good understanding of S4HANA upgrade process and supporting toolset such SAP Readiness Check with at least one contribution to the delivery of a Major release with upgraded systems in scope.
* Hands on in related supporting tools such Jira, Solution Manager, Confluence, Service\-now to support application lifecycle activities.
* Familiar with SAP activate methodology is a plus.



  





**Required Skills** 
 :
 


* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
* At ease with Microsoft Office tools, and in general with IS tools.
* Experience with multi\-geography, multi\-tier service design and management.
* Solid understanding of project management methodologies, software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies and agile practices.
* Conceptual and analytical thinking – ability to extract, analyse, and document complex business and technical requirements or strategies.



  





**Preferred Skills** 
 :
 


* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrated conflict resolution \& problem\-solving skills in a global environment.
* Strong appetite to learn and discover, entrepreneur mindset.
* Adaptable and open to change.
* Team player, service\-oriented.
* Analytical and synthetic, able to formalize solutions, good writing skills.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* With leadership attitude, autonomy and results driven.
* Role model our 4 values: teamwork, integrity, respect, courage.



  





**Education** 
 : Bachelor’s Degree (B.A.) or equivalent in Information Technology or Engineering.
 



  





**Languages** 
 : Fluent spoken and written English.

387ea32d.description:
**Job Description**
**Credit Controller\- AR (GBS Finance India)**
**JR6157416**
**Bangalore**
**Why join Rolls\-Royce?**
 At Rolls\-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.
   

  

 By joining Rolls\-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world\-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high\-performance culture.
   

  

**Summary**
 We have an opportunity for a Credit Controller in Bangalore, India.
   

  

 This is an individual contributor role to deliver Credit Control services according to process specifications and standard operating procedures (SOP) in compliance with defined controls. This includes the coordination of all processes / activities related to period closings and the timely and complete delivery of reports and insights to Business.
   

  

 In this role you report to the Finance Manager, and you closely co\-operate with the business finance teams in a matrix structure.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
**Advisory \& Credit Control**
* Analyse and evaluate new and existing customer credit worthiness \& risk exposure, recommend limit / measures in accordance with company policy and global guidelines.
* Monitor \& activate / release credit block. Advise and collaborate with Business Unit (BU) on next course of action. Release credit block with appropriate measures and approvals.
* Advise \& update internal stakeholders \& external customers on credit documentation, credit line status / extension and Group and local credit policy.
* Collaborate with BU on managing credit for customer accounts in event of sales forecast increase / decrease Responsible for the fulfilment of agreed SLAs and KPIs and for the achievement of agreed User/Customer Satisfaction levels.


**Follow up on delinquent accounts**
* Build and maintain a strong relationship with internal \& external customers.
* Lead the collections process and resolve / escalate credit and collection related issues.
* Collaborate with BU, order management and invoicing teams and customers to resolve credit, overdue, invoice rejections and disputes.
* Monitor letter of credit submission and maturity. Follow up with relevant parties (bank / customer / BU) on receipts.
* Assess provision for specific and general debts \& compute provision in accordance with Group expected credit loss model and IFRS9
* Provide commentary on overdue and account status for business steering.


**Revenue Invoicing**
* Should have a thorough understanding regarding credit note and credit invoice.
* Conduct thorough review of incoterms and performance obligations to generate and issue invoices (of all types) for customers and ensuring requirements/obligations are satisfied.
* Ensure that invoices generated are distributed, either digitally or manually based on customers’ requirements. Upload invoices on customer portals for customers that require online submission of invoices on an accurate and timely basis.
* Review the Letter of Credit (L/c) received from customers and prepare the documents in accordance with the L/c for negotiation. Should have the understanding of a letter of credit and the complexities associated with it.
* Submit L/c and invoicing documentation to banks for negotiation.
* Should be aware of the general Billing Policies and should be able to review unbilled Revenue within the given time frame.
* Should be able to investigate unbilled revenues.


**Monthly closing**
* Monitor and control cut\-off documents for monthly closing.
* Prepare monthly liquidity planning report, accounting reports and balance sheet schedules.


**Who We’re Looking For**
* Qualified Accountant/ MBA or equivalent degree in finance or accounting.
* 10\+ years of relevant working experience in area of credit management with a reputable organization.
* Experience of working in or with credit rating agencies, experience in Cash apps, collections and billing is a plus. Letter of Credit experience would also be an advantage.
* Strong credit analytical skills and knowledge of letter of credit.
* Strong in relation\-building and business partnering.
* Able to work in a global workspace.
* Good knowledge of software system e.g. SAP, Microsoft tools
* Possess initiative and ability to work independently.


 Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi\-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls\-Royce into a high\-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too. b05bb138.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice


**Team Overview**

As an Automation and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Delivery Lead within Global Operations, you will lead one of the delivery pods responsible for executing a portfolio of technology\-enabled solutions across transformation programs. This role is accountable for managing a multidisciplinary technical team delivering solutions across intelligent automation, AI/ML, workflow automation, and pro\-code application development, with a strong focus on driving measurable business outcomes.
  

  

You will be responsible for leading technical delivery resources, applying hands\-on solution architecture experience to guide implementation decisions, translating approved solution designs into scalable and sustainable delivery plans, and ensuring solutions are delivered in alignment with enterprise strategy, governance, architecture, and performance expectations. AI/ML remains a significant area of focus and direction of travel, but the role spans a broader set of solution types needed to modernize operational workflows.
  

  

You will collaborate closely with the Design team, Capability Development team, Global Operations, Global Technology, Data Science \& Analytics, and other solution partners to move prioritized opportunities from design into execution and deliver integrated, scalable solutions that create measurable business value.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in\-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  

  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

**Solution Delivery Leadership**

* Lead a delivery pod responsible for executing technology\-enabled solutions across intelligent automation, AI/ML, workflow automation, and pro\-code application development.
* Translate approved business and solution designs into actionable delivery plans, milestones, and implementation outcomes.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, sustainable, and aligned with capability standards, governance frameworks, enterprise architecture, and operational performance expectations, using hands\-on architecture experience to guide key delivery decisions.

**Collaboration with Design and Capability Development**

* Partner with Solution Design leads to receive and refine solution designs, clarify delivery requirements, and support smooth transition from design into execution.
* Collaborate with Capability Development Leads to leverage approved platforms, reusable assets, standards, and delivery patterns.
* Provide delivery feedback to inform capability maturity, solution standards, tool adoption, and future design considerations.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Collaborate with business, technology, analytics, design, and capability stakeholders to align delivery priorities, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
* Communicate solution strategy, progress, and impact to senior stakeholders.
* Facilitate cross\-functional alignment across Global Operations, Technology, Data Science, Solution Design, and Capability Development teams.

**Talent \& Resource Management**

* Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary technical delivery team, including resources supporting automation, AI/ML, workflow automation, and application development initiatives.
* Support skill development and promote a culture of innovation and experimentation.
* Manage resource allocation and team structure to support agile delivery.

**Delivery Governance**

* Ensure delivered solutions meet compliance, risk, security, ethical AI, operational readiness, and performance standards.
* Participate in governance forums to review solution progress, risks, and alignment.
Maintain transparency and accountability throughout the delivery lifecycle.  
* 

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

**Key Competencies:**

* Technology\-Enabled Solution Delivery
* Intelligent Automation, AI/ML, Workflow Automation \& Application Delivery
* Hands\-On Solution Architecture \& Technical Delivery Leadership
* Strategic Thinking
* Stakeholder Management
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration with Design, Capability, Technology, and Operations Teams
* Governance \& Compliance
* Innovation, Experimentation \& Practical Delivery Execution
* Technical Team Leadership \& Coaching
* Communication \& Influence

**Qualifications and Education:**

***What You’ll Bring:***

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Operations, Transformation, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience leading technology\-enabled transformation, automation, AI/ML, workflow, or application delivery initiatives, with 5\+ years in leadership roles.
* Proven track record leading multidisciplinary technical teams to deliver enterprise\-scale solutions that improve operational performance.
* Hands\-on technical and solution architecture experience across intelligent automation, AI/ML\-enabled solutions, workflow automation, and application delivery, with the ability to guide technical teams, assess implementation trade\-offs, and ensure delivery decisions align with enterprise standards.
* Experience partnering with process design, business operations, transformation, technology, data science, and capability teams to move solutions from concept through delivery.
* Familiarity with delivery governance, risk management, compliance expectations, ethical AI practices, and enterprise technology standards.
* Background in business operations, process transformation, or operating model change is a plus, particularly where paired with experience leading technical delivery resources.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and delivery execution skills.  
* 

  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.  



Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting\-edge technology.

e41dd1b1.description:
**Job Title:** Oracle Cloud HCMPayroll Associate (Functional consultant)
  
  

**Job Summary:**  

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud HCM Functional Consultant with minimum 5\+ years of experience with strong expertise in Core HR and UK Payroll to support Oracle Cloud HCM implementation, enhancement, testing engagements.
  
  

The ideal candidate will possess extensive functional knowledge of Oracle Cloud HCM processes and configurations, particularly within Core HR, UK Payroll, HCM Extracts, Reporting, and Integrations, and will play a key role in delivering high\-quality Oracle HCM solutions aligned with business requirements.
  
  

The consultant will be responsible for gathering and analyzing business requirements, conducting solution design workshops, configuring Oracle Cloud HCM applications, supporting testing cycles, managing defect resolution, and providing post\-production support. The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, technical consultants, project managers, and third\-party vendors to ensure successful delivery of Oracle Cloud HCM project.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* The successful candidate should possess strong functional expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud Core HR and UK Payroll, including core HR configuration, workforce structures, payroll configuration, payroll processing, payroll balances, statutory compliance, security, reporting, and data management.
* Strong communication, analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross\-functional, onsite, and offshore teams.
* Proven experience in Oracle Cloud HCM Core HR and UK Payroll implementations, enhancements, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Deep understanding of Oracle HCM Cloud Core HR, UK Payroll legislation, HMRC compliance, taxation, statutory deductions, year\-end processing, payroll controls, and end\-to\-end payroll processes.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud Core HR , UK Payroll configuration, including payroll elements, balances, payroll relationships, costing, payment methods, payroll flows, and payroll interfaces.
* Experience as a Functional Consultant collaborating with technical teams on HCM Extracts, OTBI, BI Publisher Reports, HDL/HSDL, Fast Formulas, data migration, and integrations.
* Participation in at least 4–5 full lifecycle Oracle HCM Cloud implementation projects, with significant involvement in UK Payroll delivery.
* Strong experience in business requirement gathering, fit\-gap analysis, solution design, functional documentation, stakeholder management, and client\-facing consulting engagements.
* Hands\-on experience supporting data migration, reconciliation, payroll parallel testing, payroll validation, SIT, UAT, cutover, go\-live, hypercare, and post\-production support.
* Experience analyzing defects, performing root cause analysis, supporting issue resolution, and ensuring data integrity, security, and compliance.
* Good understanding of Oracle Cloud HCM integration points with Core HR, Absence Management, Time and Labor, Finance, and downstream systems.
* Ability to assess the impact of statutory changes, business changes, and Oracle quarterly updates on payroll processes and configurations.

* Configure and manage Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Contact Builder, Content Builder, and Data Extensions
* Create customer journeys, audience segmentation, and personalized marketing campaigns
* Execute campaign deployments and monitor campaign performance
* Manage subscriber data, preference centers, and data synchronization
* Build SQL queries for segmentation and campaign optimization
* Generate campaign reports and support marketing analytics
* Ensure adherence to Marketing Cloud best practices, governance, and email deliverability standards

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* 6 to 9 years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience
* Experience implementing Sales Cloud and Service Cloud solutions
* Strong experience with Salesforce platform customization, integrations, and automation
* Experience working with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement, including campaign development and customer journeys
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies and source control practices
* Proficiency in Triggers, Integrations \- REST APIs, SOQL \& SOSL
* Skills in Campaign Management, Email Deliverability, Email Personalization

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with Flows, Security \& Sharing Model, Platform Events
* Knowledge of Change Data Capture (CDC), Named Credentials, Asynchronous Apex (Batch, Queueable, Future, Scheduled)
* Background in Git and CI/CD tools, Agile/Scrum methodology
* Hands\-on experience with Agentforce and AI\-enabled Salesforce capabilities
* Familiarity with Marketing Cloud Engagement, Audience Segmentation, Subscriber \& Preference Management
* Knowledge of Marketing Analytics \& Reporting
* Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Administrator, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, Marketing Cloud Email Specialist/Developer

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

44692735.title: Solution Engineer / Product Lead — GxP
44692735.description:
**About The Role**
 Be the founder’s second\-in\-room: run the demos, map the workflows, and walk Heads of Quality through the evidence — with a defined track to Product Lead as our first design partnerships convert.
   

  

 Every buyer conversation we have is with a Head of Quality, VP Quality, or QA/CSV leader — people who detect hand\-waving instantly. Your job is to make Verixa concrete in those rooms. The product is built and internally tested, and we are entering paid design\-partner engagements with emerging pharma, biotech and CDMO quality teams — India first, US in parallel. You would be hire \#1 in the Hyderabad market team.
   

  

**About Verixa**
 Verixa is a governed\-AI workflow platform for regulated life sciences, built by Navira Quality Systems. We apply bounded AI assistance inside regulated quality workflows — deviation investigation, RCA, CAPA, audit preparation — with human review, source traceability, controlled approvals and workflow\-level audit records on every AI\-assisted step. AI can propose; qualified humans determine and approve the regulated decision.
   

  

 The product is built and internally tested, and we are entering paid design\-partner engagements with emerging pharma, biotech and CDMO quality teams — India first, US in parallel. The founder spent 20\+ years in pharma quality (Genentech/Roche, BMS, Arcellx, Alumis) and leads every sale personally. You would be hire \#1 in the Hyderabad market team.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Run the demo — own the demo environment, demo scripts and scenario data. Show a deviation → RCA → CAPA workflow credibly to people who live it daily.
* Map workflows live — sit with a customer’s QA team, take their SOP/process reality, and map it to a bounded Verixa workflow: scope, roles, review gates, exclusions.
* Walk the evidence — present AI output provenance, supporting sources, reviewer history, system records and validation\-support documentation, and answer “how would this hold up in an inspection?” without overclaiming.
* Be the founder’s second\-in\-room — join design\-partner meetings, capture what was actually said and agreed, challenge our own optimism, and own same\-day follow\-ups.
* Feed the product — turn what buyers say into precise input for the product and engineering team: workflow scope, priorities and honest claims. This is where the Product Lead track begins.


 The Product Lead track
   

  

 This role is deliberately built to grow. Prove the solution\-engineering seat through our first paid design partnerships, and the product\-definition mandate — workflow roadmap, scope decisions, the bridge to our engineering team — formalizes into a Product Lead title. We would rather promote the person who has sat in fifty buyer meetings than hire a product leader who hasn’t.
   

  

 What we’re looking for
   

  

* 4–10 years in pharma/biotech quality reality: plant or clinical QA, CSV/CSA, QMS/eQMS implementation, or quality consulting. You can read a deviation SOP and find the pain in it.
* You can demo software — vendor solution\-engineering, implementation consulting, or having led an eQMS/LIMS rollout from the customer side all count.
* You speak both languages — QA (“root cause, impact assessment, Part 11”) and product (“workflow, config, role model”) — and translate between them.
* Startup pace, regulatory discipline — you move quickly without compromising evidence, accuracy or claim discipline.
* Claim discipline — Verixa is internally tested and provides validation\-support documentation; each regulated customer remains responsible for validating the system for its intended use within its quality system. If stating that plainly resonates rather than frustrates, you’ll fit.
* Based in Hyderabad, or ready to relocate.


 Nice to have
   

  

* Exposure to AI/ML tools in a regulated context.
* Annex 11 / Part 11 working knowledge.
* CDMO or sterile\-manufacturing background.
* An existing Hyderabad pharma network.


 What this role is not
   

  

* Not a pure sales quota role — the founder leads sales.
* Not remote.
* Not a support desk.
* It is the most customer\-facing technical seat in the company.


 What you get
   

  

* A ground\-floor seat in one of India’s largest life\-sciences and pharma hubs, as the market team’s first hire — employed by Navira Quality Systems with meaningful early\-employee ESOP.
* Direct daily work with a domain\-expert founder; your fingerprints on the product, the demo and the first reference customers — and a defined Product Lead growth track.
* A front\-row seat to the evolving AI and computerized\-systems regulatory landscape — draft EU Annex 22, Annex 11 developments, FDA Part 11 expectations and, for medical\-device applications, FDA CSA.


 Compensation. Competitive salary \+ ESOP, calibrated to experience.
   

  

 We hire on merit; quality people know evidence beats narrative.

* Assist in building and delivering content for marketing events, acting as a liaison to enhance customer engagement and showcase GitHub's value proposition.
* Synthesize and communicate business and industry insights to identify growth opportunities and align product features with customer digital transformation initiatives.
* Design and develop innovative solutions that leverage GitHub's platform capabilities to address complex customer challenges, ensuring alignment with their strategic goals.
* Collaborate with sales and account management teams and partners to develop strategic account plans that drive long\-term customer success and growth.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* 4\+ years’ experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience,
+ OR bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 2\+ years’ experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience,
+ OR master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field,
+ OR equivalent experience.


**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1\+ year(s) experience in digital transformation using software modernization to drive customer business outcomes
* 1\+ year(s) experience in business consulting, consultative selling, or customer facing experience
* Proficiency in enterprise software development and application security practices, including experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools, as well as a deep understanding of GitHub Advanced Security and CodeQL
* Demonstrated success in technical consultative selling, with the ability to engage in strategic discussions with customers and influence decision\-making processes
* Demonstrated success in driving customer satisfaction and retention through proactive support and relationship management, showcasing an ability to build long\-term partnerships


**GitHub values**
* Customer\-obsessed
* Ship to learn
* Growth mindset
* Own the outcome
* Better together
* Diverse and inclusive


**Manager fundamentals**
* Model
* Coach
* Care


**Leadership principles**
* Create clarity
* Generate energy
* Deliver success


**Who We Are**
 GitHub is the world’s leading AI\-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open\-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open\-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
   

  

 Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote\-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
   

  

 Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking a skilled **Salesforce CRM \& Marketing Cloud Developer** with hands\-on experience in Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Salesforce Platform, Agentforce, and Marketing Cloud Engagement.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and Lightning Platform
* Configure and customize Sales Cloud and Service Cloud to support business processes
* Develop reusable components and automation following Salesforce best practices
* Design and implement integrations with external applications using REST APIs and middleware
* Configure security, sharing, profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchy
* Develop asynchronous processing using Batch Apex, Queueable Apex, Future Methods, and Platform Events
* Build AI\-powered business solutions using Agentforce, Prompt Builder, and Einstein capabilities
* Participate in solution design, code reviews, testing, deployments, and production support
* Troubleshoot application issues and optimize system performance
* Create technical documentation and support Agile delivery processes
* Design, build, test, and deploy email campaigns using Marketing Cloud Engagement
* Develop responsive email templates using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and JavaScript
* Configure and manage Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Contact Builder, Content Builder, and Data Extensions
* Create customer journeys, audience segmentation, and personalized marketing campaigns
* Execute campaign deployments and monitor campaign performance
* Manage subscriber data, preference centers, and data synchronization
* Build SQL queries for segmentation and campaign optimization
* Generate campaign reports and support marketing analytics
* Ensure adherence to Marketing Cloud best practices, governance, and email deliverability standards

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* 6 to 9 years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience
* Experience implementing Sales Cloud and Service Cloud solutions
* Strong experience with Salesforce platform customization, integrations, and automation
* Experience working with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement, including campaign development and customer journeys
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies and source control practices
* Proficiency in Triggers, Integrations \- REST APIs, SOQL \& SOSL
* Skills in Campaign Management, Email Deliverability, Email Personalization

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with Flows, Security \& Sharing Model, Platform Events
* Knowledge of Change Data Capture (CDC), Named Credentials, Asynchronous Apex (Batch, Queueable, Future, Scheduled)
* Background in Git and CI/CD tools, Agile/Scrum methodology
* Hands\-on experience with Agentforce and AI\-enabled Salesforce capabilities
* Familiarity with Marketing Cloud Engagement, Audience Segmentation, Subscriber \& Preference Management
* Knowledge of Marketing Analytics \& Reporting
* Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Administrator, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, Marketing Cloud Email Specialist/Developer

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development

9e82f162.description:
* Job ID: 860237
* 4 \- 6 Years
* 1 Opening
* Hyderabad, Kolkata


  
### **Role description**


Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Discrete Manufacturing \& Planning Consultant with strong functional expertise in Discrete Manufacturing, Supply Planning, Demand Management, and related SCM modules. The consultant will be responsible for end\-to\-end implementation, configuration, support, and optimization of Oracle Fusion Manufacturing and Planning solutions, ensuring alignment with business processes and industry best practices.


Key Responsibilities


Oracle Fusion Manufacturing (Discrete)


Configure and support Oracle Fusion Discrete Manufacturing modules including:


Work Definitions (Standard \& Model)


Work Orders (Discrete \& Non\-standard)


Work Execution and Work Order Operations


Resources, Work Centers, and Work Areas


Standard Costing / Actual Costing integration


Define and manage:


Bills of Material (BOM)


Routings and Operations


UOMs, Item Attributes, and Manufacturing Parameters


Support manufacturing transactions such as material issues, completions, scrap, and returns


Integrate Manufacturing with Inventory, Cost Management, Quality, and Maintenance modules


Oracle Fusion Planning


Implement and support Oracle Fusion Planning Central modules:


Demand Management


Supply Planning


Sales \& Operations Planning (S\&OP) / Integrated Business Planning (IBP)


Configure:


Demand Classes and Forecast Profiles


Planning Measures and Plan Options


Sourcing Rules and Assignment Sets


Safety Stock and Replenishment policies


Perform plan runs, analyze exceptions, and recommend corrective actions


Collaborate with business users to improve forecast accuracy and supply responsiveness


Functional \& Business Process


Conduct requirement gathering workshops and map business requirements to Oracle Fusion functionality


Prepare Functional Design Documents (FDD), Setup Documents, and Business Process Flows


Perform system configuration, testing (SIT/UAT), and deployment support


Provide post\-go\-live support and continuous improvement recommendations


Integration \& Reporting


Work closely with technical teams on integrations using REST/SOAP, FBDI, and ADFdi


Support data migration activities for items, BOMs, routings, and transactional data


Assist in developing OTBI / BI Publisher reports for Manufacturing and Planning


Stakeholder \& Project Management


Interact with business users, IT teams, and external partners


Provide training and knowledge transfer to end users


Support audits, compliance, and documentation requirements


Required Skills \& Qualifications


Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle Fusion SCM Manufacturing and Planning modules


In\-depth knowledge of Discrete Manufacturing business processes


Strong understanding of MRP, MPS, Forecasting, and Capacity Planning concepts


Experience in at least 1–2 end\-to\-end Oracle Fusion implementations


Good knowledge of Inventory, Cost Management, and Procurement integration


Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills


Preferred Skills


Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud releases and quarterly updates


Exposure to Oracle Quality Management or Maintenance Cloud


Knowledge of SQL for data validation and analysis


Experience working in manufacturing industries such as Automotive, Engineering, or Electronics


Education


Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or equivalent


Oracle Fusion SCM certification is a plus

  

  

Skills  



  

Oracle Fusion Manufacturing (Discrete)


Oracle Fusion Planning


Oracle SCM AI Agents


### **Skills**


Oracle Fusion Discrete Manufacturing (Primary)


Oracle Fusion Supply/Demand Planning (Secondary skill\- Good to Have)


  
### **About Grant Thornton INDUS**


‘Grant Thornton INDUS’ comprises GT U.S. Shared Services Center India Pvt Ltd and Grant Thornton U.S. Knowledge and Capability Center India Pvt Ltd. Grant Thornton INDUS is the shared services center supporting the operations of Grant Thornton LLP, the U.S. member firm of Grant Thornton International Ltd. What sets us apart isn’t just what we do – it’s how we do it. We support and enable the firm’s purpose of making business more personal and building trust into every result. We’re collaborators – obsessed with quality and ready for anything – who understand the value of strong relationships. Our professionals are well integrated to seamlessly support the U.S. engagement teams, help increase Grant Thornton’s access to a wide talent pool, and improve operational efficiencies. Empowered people, bold leadership, and distinctive client service are imbibed in the culture at Grant Thornton INDUS. We are a transparent, competitive, and excellence\-driven firm that offers an opportunity to be part of something significant. In addition, professionals at Grant Thornton INDUS serve communities in India through inspirational and generous services to give back to the communities they work in. 0b974de2.title: Cloud Security - Senior Consultant
0b974de2.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever\-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for supporting clients in strengthening and operating security capabilities across hybrid cloud environments.
   

  

* Support the design and implementation of security solutions for hybrid cloud environments aligned to client requirements and industry practices
* Collaborate with clients and cross\-functional teams to translate security requirements into technical solutions and operational processes
* Manage and monitor cloud security operations, including incident queues, ticket updates, escalation management, and service level adherence
* Assist with the deployment and configuration of security controls across public and private cloud environments
* Contribute to compliance, governance, automation, and continuous improvement efforts across cloud security operations


**The team**
 Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting\-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
   

  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance


 Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai
   

  

**Shift Timings:** 
 24\*7 rotational shifts; night, weekend, and holiday coverage; on\-call support based on project assignment
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information security, engineering, or a related field
* 5\-10 years of experience in information technology, information security, or both
* Experience with at least one public cloud platform such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Experience with firewalls, virtual private clouds (VPCs), security groups, key management, and secure software development life cycle (SDLC) pipelines
* Experience identifying security gaps and implementing security controls across cloud infrastructure
* Experience with DevOps practices and automation of software testing, delivery, or infrastructure changes
* Experience with regulatory or control frameworks such as National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Payment Card Industry (PCI), International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 27001, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), or SOC 2
* Experience with log collection and storage tools such as Splunk or Elastic Stack


 Preferred:
   

  

* Relevant certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, or Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Prior consulting experience, including Big 4 experience
* Experience with scripting, tooling, or automation used to streamline recurring operate tasks


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

2b67050d.description:
**Technical Architect / Engineering Manager (Hands\-On)** 




**Experience Level:** 
 10 – 15 Years
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata
 







**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a visionary, execution\-focused
 **Hands\-On Technical Architect / Engineering Manager** 
 with 10 to 15 years of deep software engineering experience to lead our cross\-functional engineering initiatives.
 



 You will act as the primary technical authority and hands\-on lead—analyzing existing legacy/complex systems, designing modern scalable architectures, writing high\-impact code, and guiding a team of junior to mid\-level engineers from concept to production delivery.
 



 You will bridge the gap between high\-level business strategy and deep, hands\-on execution across a broad technology spectrum including Cloud, Microservices, DevOps, Networking, and emerging AI/GenAI paradigms.
 







**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Hands\-On Coding, Design \& Architecture** 



* **Active Coding \& Prototyping:** 
 Maintain an active role in writing production code, building Proof\-of\-Concepts (PoCs), authoring core system components, and unblocking the team on complex technical issues.
* **System Architecture \& Design:** 
 Architect robust, secure, and fault\-tolerant distributed systems spanning frontend applications, backend microservices, cloud infrastructures, and data pipelines.
* **System Analysis \& Modernization:** 
 Audit, analyze, and reverse\-engineer existing architectures/legacy codebases to eliminate technical debt, improve reliability, optimize performance, and reduce cloud costs.
* **AI \& Innovation Integration:** 
 Hands\-on implementation of production\-grade AI/ML and Generative AI patterns (e.g., LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, AI Agents, Vector DBs) into enterprise applications.
* **Networking \& Security:** 
 Design and implement secure cloud networking topology (VPCs, API Gateways, Load Balancers, IAM, Zero\-Trust network security).



**2\. Technical Leadership \& Project Execution** 



* **Technical Roadmap \& Scoping:** 
 Work with product management to translate high\-level business goals into actionable engineering roadmaps, technical specs, and sprint breakdown plans.
* **Quality \& Standards:** 
 Conduct rigorous code reviews, establish engineering best practices, enforce strict unit/integration testing, and maintain code quality across the team.
* **DevOps \& Operational Excellence:** 
 Set up and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), containerization, distributed tracing, and production observability.



**3\. Team Management \& Mentorship** 



* **Lead by Example:** 
 Independently manage and guide junior and mid\-level software engineers through structured feedback, pair programming, and architectural mentorship.
* **Engineering Culture:** 
 Foster a hands\-on culture of technical rigor, fast\-paced execution, continuous integration, and technical growth.







**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 




**Overall Experience** 



* **10 to 15 years** 
 of total software engineering experience, with a proven track record of remaining
 **actively hands\-on with coding and system design** 
 throughout your career.
* At least
 **3–5 years** 
 in a Technical Architect, Tech Lead, or Engineering Lead capacity directly delivering enterprise\-scale platforms.







**Technical Stack Expertise** 




**Domain** 




**Required Skills \& Technologies** 




**Hands\-On Backend \& APIs** 




 Expert\-level coding skills in one or more core languages:
 **Java, Python, or Node.js** 
 ; deep expertise in RESTful APIs, GraphQL, Microservices, and Event\-Driven Architectures (Kafka/RabbitMQ).
 



**Frontend** 




 Hands\-on experience or solid architectural understanding of modern Web frameworks (
 **React, Angular, Next.js, or Vue.js** 
 ), state management, performance optimization, and SSR/CSR paradigms.
 



**Cloud Computing** 




 Hands\-on architectural and configuration mastery in
 **AWS, Azure, or GCP** 
 (Serverless, Compute, Managed Databases, Object Storage, API Gateways).
 



**DevOps \& IaC** 




 Hands\-on experience with
 **Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE/AKS), Terraform / CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD** 
 , and observability platforms.
 



**Networking \& Infra** 




 Deep understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, VPC peering, Load Balancing, CDN integration, and Cloud Security standards.
 



**AI / ML \& GenAI** 




 Practical implementation experience with
 **LLM APIs, RAG architectures, Vector Databases (Pinecone/Milvus/pgvector), LangChain/LlamaIndex** 
 , or cloud AI services (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI).
 







**Analytical \& Leadership Skills** 



* **Problem Solving:** 
 Exceptional ability to decompose highly complex, ambiguous business problems into clean technical architecture and working code.
* **System Analysis:** 
 Demonstrated ability to dive deep into unfamiliar codebases, run performance profiling, identify bottlenecks, and refactor code safely.
* **Communication:** 
 Clear verbal and written communication skills to explain complex designs to stakeholders and coach team members through architecture reviews.



**Preferred / Bonus Skills** 



* Relevant Cloud Certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or GCP Professional Cloud Architect).
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps pipeline automation and AI governance frameworks.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

**Technical \& Domain Skills**

6fa5652b.title: Distributed Systems Architect
6fa5652b.description:
**About Us**
 Are you ready to build the future of supply chain? At Gather AI, we're not just creating software; we're pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We've developed a groundbreaking, vision\-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real\-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error\-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining "on\-time, in full" delivery. If you're looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We're leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.
   

  

**About You**
 As a Distributed Systems Architect at Gather AI you will serve as a technical anchor for our engineering organization. This role is for someone who thrives on the challenge of evolving mature, complex SaaS systems, setting technical direction, architecture, and ensuring our platforms remain reliable and perform as we scale. To be successful in this role, you must be able to design, evaluate, and guide decisions across the entire stack—from database internals to distributed service patterns.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own Architecture: Align backend, frontend, platform, and infrastructure decisions into a coherent, enterprise\-grade architecture.
* Reflect Excellence: Replace "firefighting" with predictable execution. You will lead the effort to retire scalability and reliability debt, safely upgrade critical infrastructure, and reduce single\-threaded dependencies.
* Set Direction: Set the standard for engineering technical hygiene. You will drive high\-level decisions on testing strategies, validation guardrails, and system design concerns that directly impact delivery speed and maintainability.
* Evolve Systems: Modernize and scale existing production systems by applying database\-level strategies (schema evolution, replication tradeoffs) and platform primitives (orchestration, runtime constraints) as architectural tools.
* Mentor: Elevate the organization by establishing shared practices, aligning terminology, and mentoring senior talent across the engineering team.
* Exhibit First\-Principles Thinking: Establish a deep understanding of data systems, latency\-sensitive services, and failure modes.


**Requirements:**
* Distributed Systems: Mastery of performance\-sensitive REST APIs, caching strategies, and core distributed systems concepts.
* Relational Data Systems: Expert\-level PostgreSQL (upgrades, query tuning, replication tradeoffs, and schema evolution) and advanced SQL.
* Cloud \& Containers: Deep experience with Azure and/or AWS and production\-grade Kubernetes/Docker.
* Backend Development: Strong production experience in Node.js and/or Python.
* Reliability \& Security: Hands\-on experience with Observability (logs, metrics, traces), CI/CD, SRE fundamentals (SLIs/SLOs), and security hygiene (IAM, secrets management).


**Bonus points for...**
* Domain Expertise: Experience in logistics, warehouse systems, or robotics\-adjacent platforms is a plus, but not required. We value your ability to apply sound architectural judgment to new problem spaces.
* Future Scale: If you have operated at a slightly smaller scale but can reason clearly about "what breaks next" (e.g., multi\-regional architectures or advanced data governance), we will help you bridge that gap.
* Organizational Maturity: While we value experience driving org\-wide standards, we don't expect perfection on day one. We look for the intent to elevate our shared practices as you build trust.
* AI\-Ready: At Gather, we are at the leading edge of both applied classical ML and next\-gen LLM/VLM AI. Come prepared to work with the latest and greatest tooling.


**Why This Role?**
 In this position, you won't just be writing code; you will be designing the future of a scaling organization with the autonomy to solve high\-stakes problems.

3dfa2ec2.title: Associate Solution Architect (Financial Research, CFA Preferred)
3dfa2ec2.description:
**Description**
 The Associate Solution Architect will be responsible for providing technical leadership and full\-stack development of CFRA’s next generation of web applications using a modern technology stack: React and Python on AWS cloud infrastructure. This is a rare opportunity to make a big impact on both the team and the organization by being part of the initial design and development of a new customer\-facing application framework that will serve as the foundation for all future web development at CFRA.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has a passion for solving business problems with technology and can effectively communicate business and technical needs to stakeholders. We are looking for candidates that value collaboration with superb colleagues and having an immediate, tangible impact for a leading global independent financial insights and data company.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop high\-quality, high\-performance, scalable applications using best practices and the latest generation of technologies
* Provide technical leadership to multiple teams throughout the project lifecycle
* Provide recommendations and roadmaps for proposed solutions
* Perform design, debug, and performance analysis on solutions
* Document and sharing best practice knowledge for new solutions
* Review and validate solution designs from other team members
* Mentor and work skilled teams while shaping the future of our products
* Produce technical design documents and conduct technical walkthroughs
* Document and demonstrate solutions using technical design docs, diagrams, and stubbed code
* Follow Agile best practices effectively and actively participate in all scrum ceremonies
* Respond to and resolve production issues
* Be part of a culture of continuous learning and improvement of both the team and codebase


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

* A minimum of 12\+ years of full stack development experience on enterprise web applications
* A minimum of 5 years of experience leading a development team
* Proficient in frontend development using React/Typescript
* Proficient in backend development using Python or an object\-oriented language
* Fluency in the AWS infrastructure for delivering web applications: API Gateway, Lambda, Cognito, CloudFront, S3
* Proficient in SQL and developing solutions using relational databases such as MySQL.
* Experience using object\-oriented design principles and building backend applications with REST APIs
* Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure as code technologies
* Experience with Git and continuous integration environments
* Experience with code pipelines such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipline
* Experience with frontend and backend unit testing methodologies
* Proficient with software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies like Agile
* CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) designation with hands\-on experience in financial equity research is a strong plus, providing domain expertise in financial statement analysis, valuation, and investment research that translates directly into more informed design of CFRA's research and analytics platforms
* Excellent analytical and communication skills are essential, with strong verbal and writing proficiencies
* Ability to train and mentor
* Great organizational and time\-management skills, including an ability to estimate project completion times
* Ability to take complex technical concepts and communicate to non\-technical audience
* Ability to juggle multiple projects, tasks, and deadlines
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or Engineering is required


**Benefits**
* 21 days of Vacation
* 8 Sick Days
* 1 paid volunteer day
* 11 \- 13 Holidays a year
* Health Insurance
* Company paid Life \& Disability Insurance
* Competitive Pay
* Annual Performance Bonus


**About CFRA Research**
 CFRA is a global leader in independent investment insights and data analytics. With a heritage dating back to the 1920s, we provide actionable analytics through a multidisciplinary approach—including forensic accounting, fundamental, and policy research.
   

  

 Our team of over 90 global analysts provides in\-depth qualitative research on 1,600\+ companies and 34,000\+ funds, quantitative research on over 20,000 global companies. Headquartered in the US with a significant presence across Europe and Asia, CFRA serves over 2,000 clients. We remain committed to providing the independent, differentiated analysis our clients need to make superior investment and business decisions.
   

  

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.*

a65f33d9.title: Cloud Security - Senior Consultant
a65f33d9.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever\-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for supporting clients in strengthening and operating security capabilities across hybrid cloud environments.
   

  

* Support the design and implementation of security solutions for hybrid cloud environments aligned to client requirements and industry practices
* Collaborate with clients and cross\-functional teams to translate security requirements into technical solutions and operational processes
* Manage and monitor cloud security operations, including incident queues, ticket updates, escalation management, and service level adherence
* Assist with the deployment and configuration of security controls across public and private cloud environments
* Contribute to compliance, governance, automation, and continuous improvement efforts across cloud security operations


**The team**
 Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting\-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
   

  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance


 Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai
   

  

**Shift Timings:** 
 24\*7 rotational shifts; night, weekend, and holiday coverage; on\-call support based on project assignment
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information security, engineering, or a related field
* 5\-10 years of experience in information technology, information security, or both
* Experience with at least one public cloud platform such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Experience with firewalls, virtual private clouds (VPCs), security groups, key management, and secure software development life cycle (SDLC) pipelines
* Experience identifying security gaps and implementing security controls across cloud infrastructure
* Experience with DevOps practices and automation of software testing, delivery, or infrastructure changes
* Experience with regulatory or control frameworks such as National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Payment Card Industry (PCI), International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 27001, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), or SOC 2
* Experience with log collection and storage tools such as Splunk or Elastic Stack


 Preferred:
   

  

* Relevant certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, or Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Prior consulting experience, including Big 4 experience
* Experience with scripting, tooling, or automation used to streamline recurring operate tasks


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.
