f5dba7c7.title: Architect - Infra
f5dba7c7.description:
**Overview**  

Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.

 **Responsibilities**  

Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment

  

Gathers customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. Identifies and evaluates industry trends (customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry). Adapts business models, plans, and solutions to insights.

  

Works with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution. Where the cost of change is accepted by the customer, shares this feedback with the project team and the broader account team to make the necessary adjustments using mechanisms such as updating the solution approach and projected costs in presales and change requests in delivery. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.

  

Uses evidence\-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and shares insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services, and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.

  

Architecture Design and Deployment

  

Leverages a structured approach to Architecture Projects using existing methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Iterative) that make use of existing reference architecture and established architectural styles and design patterns. Proposes and develops new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood.

  

Defines and documents the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Leads complex cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the Architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Uses a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution.

  

Collaborates with the Project Manager to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots, using enterprise architecture processes and ensuring quality control through peer review. Works with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realize.

  

Works with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Manages and resolves complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Maintains the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Drives development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer. Where there are defects, works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Customer to redress or accept and document the status of the test results.

  

Collaborates with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex Solution Approach with traceability of requirements, constraints, decisions, and tradeoffs that balances risk, technical credibility, and technical innovation to meet customer need, predominantly based on existing solution offerings and/or reference architecture. Jointly leads the implementation in close partnership with the Project Manager. Leads oversight and governance and establishment of quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Uses a cohesive build methodology with an agreed release schedule and timeline so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Works with the Project Manager to highlight where assumptions have proven false. Uses change requests to modify the Solution/project approach when needed. As needed, collaborates with subject matter experts to receive specialized advice that can help define the Solution and project approach and increase the time to value for the customer.

  

Anticipates and identifies scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with account/project team to resolve non\-technical issues. Reports significant problems to Microsoft management and resolves escalations when needed. Plans a way forward in complex and ambiguous situations with an innovative approach and durable design. Delegates and leverages specialist skills of others to drive technical alignment across internal/external teams. Coordinates disparate approaches into a single plan of action for complex scenarios.

  

Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary.

  

Practice Development

  

Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities.

  

Trusted Advisor

  

Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.

  

Uses evidence\-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed.

  

Leads the adoption of Microsoft solutions technologies based on understanding of competitor solutions and how customer business value can be driven through Microsoft's offerings. Differentiates Microsoft's solutions in customer/partner conversations to influence the industry\-wide direction for specific architecture(s).

  

Thought Leadership

  

Leads virtual teams around technologies and customer/partner challenges by sharing ideas, insight, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger virtual team across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape.

  

Participates in external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons) and shares learnings with internal team. Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Demonstrates deep industry knowledge and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences.

  

Other

  

Embody our culture and values

 **Qualifications**  

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent work experience) relevant to Information Technology, Computer Science/Engineering.


At least 12\-14\+ years related IT experience with Solution Architecture having experience in enterprise\-scale technical experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, architecture designs, database migrations, and technology management.


Work experience should involve pre\-sales support on large deals in technical consulting, solution design of complex solutions, project envisioning, planning, development, deployment, and Team management.


Must have a proven record of delivering business value and proven trust\-relationships with CxO, ITDM, BDM


The job may require travel.


Fluent English verbal and written communications skills are a must.

  

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the Accommodation request form.Benefits/perks listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Microsoft and the country where you work.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. 19c9bb76.title: Bid Manager
19c9bb76.description:
The
 **Bid Manager** 
 will lead the end\-to\-end management of government and enterprise RFP, RFI, and RFQ opportunities, ensuring the delivery of high\-quality, compliant, and competitive proposals. The role requires close collaboration with cross\-functional teams, strong attention to detail, and the ability to articulate complex analytics and technology solutions effectively. As a key contributor to business growth, the Tender and Bid Manager will drive timely bid submissions and enhance win rates through structured pursuit management and proposal excellence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Own the end\-to\-end bid lifecycle** 
 for government and enterprise opportunities, including opportunity assessment, bid qualification, strategy development, proposal preparation, governance reviews, and final submission.
* **Develop and drive bid execution plans** 
 , ensuring clear milestones, stakeholder alignment, and adherence to submission timelines to maximize pursuit success.
* **Analyze RFP/RFI/RFQ and tender documents** 
 to identify customer requirements, evaluation criteria, compliance obligations, risks, and key differentiators needed to craft winning responses.
* **Collaborate across cross\-functional teams** 
 including Sales, Solutioning, Delivery, Legal, Finance, Product, and Operations to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and ensure proposal completeness.
* **Lead proposal development activities** 
 , creating compelling, customer\-focused content that clearly articulates business value, solution capabilities, and competitive advantages.
* **Write, review, edit, and integrate proposal responses** 
 to ensure consistency, accuracy, quality, and full compliance with customer requirements and organizational standards.
* **Manage commercial and compliance submissions** 
 , ensuring all pricing, contractual, legal, and regulatory requirements are accurately addressed and approved.
* **Ensure Proposal are uploaded** 
 in customer portals or submitted with necessary RFP/RFI stated documents in timely manner.
* **Maintain a centralized bid knowledge repository** 
 , including proposal templates, reusable content, case studies, credentials, past submissions, and response libraries to improve bid efficiency and quality.
* **Conduct customer, market, and competitor research** 
 to understand client priorities, align solution positioning, and strengthen win strategies.
* **Monitor government procurement portals, tender aggregators, and industry sources** 
 to identify upcoming opportunities and support proactive pursuit planning.
* **Coordinate post\-submission activities** 
 , including clarification responses, customer presentations, negotiations, BAFO submissions, and internal debriefs.
* **Ensure 100% compliance** 
 with bid submission guidelines, eligibility criteria, governance checkpoints, and contractual requirements while meeting all deadlines.
* **Track bid performance metrics and win/loss outcomes** 
 , providing insights and recommendations to improve bid effectiveness, proposal quality, and win rates.
* **Drive continuous improvement in bid management practices** 
 , establishing standardized processes, governance frameworks, and best practices to enhance organizational bidding capability.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

a9c02df5.title: Bid Manager
a9c02df5.description:
**Purpose of the role**
 The Bid Manager is responsible for the end‑to‑end coordination and delivery of high‑quality, client‑focused bids, proposals and presentations for existing and prospective clients.
   

  

 Working closely with the Chief Client Officers, the VP Client Engagement community, Business Development, Solutions and other senior stakeholders, the role ensures that pursuit responses are completed on time, to a high standard of quality, and in line with brand, sales frameworks and best practice.
   

  

 Through strong written communication, effective coordination and attention to detail, the Bid Manager adds value to each pursuit by helping to shape win themes, tailoring content to the agreed pursuit strategy, and driving consistency and quality across all submissions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Coordinate the end‑to‑end bid and proposal process for assigned pursuits, ensuring all responses are delivered on time, to a high standard of quality, and in line with brand and sales best practice
* Work closely with Client Engagement, Business Development, Solutions and subject‑matter experts to gather, develop and refine content for proposals, presentations and RFx responses
* Create, adapt and tailor written and visual content to reflect client requirements, scope and evaluation criteria
* Arrange, prepare for and chair bid kick‑off and progress meetings, maintaining clear response schedules, actions and accountability
* Manage contribution reviews, proofreading and quality checks to ensure accuracy, consistency and clarity across all submissions
* Champion best practice within the bid process, including maintaining accurate pipeline records and supporting qualification and prioritisation activities
* Use established tools, templates and content libraries to support efficient collaboration and delivery
* Work closely with offshore or remote support teams to coordinate inputs and maintain quality standards
* Contribute to management information and reporting on bid activity, quality and performance where required
* Collaborate with the wider growth function to embed and refine best practices, drive consistency and support the rollout of new initiatives that drive efficiency and competitive advantage through new business processes with an ongoing focus on leveraging AI within the function


**Knowledge, skills \+ experience**
* Advanced written English skills, with the ability to create, refine and tailor clear, concise and client‑focused written content
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across Client Engagement, Business Development, Solutions and other stakeholders
* Experience coordinating bids, proposals or similar complex documents within fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environments
* Ability to interpret client requirements, scopes and evaluation criteria and translate these into structured, compliant responses
* Experience working within remote, multi‑regional teams; experience working with offshore support teams is desirable
* Strong organisational and time‑management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously
* High attention to detail, with a commitment to quality, accuracy and consistency across all outputs
* Commercial awareness sufficient to support proposal development, including coordination of pricing and commercial model inputs
* Confidence using standard bid tools, templates and content libraries, and core productivity tools (e.g. Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
* Comfortable operating in a high‑energy, time‑pressured environment, with resilience and adaptability under pressure

5b9e3e75.title: Solutions Consultant
5b9e3e75.description:
**Company Description** 
 CRIF India is a leading provider of credit information, business information, analytics, scoring, credit management, and decision solutions, operating through CRIF High Mark and CRIF Solutions Pvt. Ltd. CRIF High Mark is an RBI\-licensed credit bureau with one of India’s largest databases of individuals and businesses, supporting millions of lending decisions each month and hosting the world’s largest microfinance bureau database. CRIF Solutions delivers advanced analytics and scoring services, credit management solutions, decision platforms, and business information reports to diverse clients. As part of the global CRIF group, recognized in the FinTech 100, CRIF India leverages international best practices across 37 countries to provide high\-quality, technology\-driven solutions. Headquartered in Mumbai with development and operations in Pune, CRIF India employs over 500 professionals and serves banks, financial institutions, insurers, telecom providers, and enterprises across India.
 


**Role Description**

  





 We are looking for a Solutions Consultant to join our Product \& Consulting Team. This role combines credit underwriting expertise, business consulting, and solution implementation to help banks and financial institutions transform their lending and credit decisioning processes.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will work closely with Sales, Product, and Delivery teams to understand client underwriting policies, configure business rules in CRIF’s Business Rules Engine (BRE), support solution demonstrations, and guide clients through solution design and implementation.
 



  





 This role is ideal for professionals with hands\-on experience in lending or credit underwriting who enjoy solving business problems through technology.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 • Understand client lending processes, credit policies, and business requirements.
 



 • Configure and implement credit decision logic within CRIF’s Business Rules Engine (BRE).
 



 • Translate underwriting policies into configurable decision rules, scorecards, workflows, and decision strategies.
 



 • Support pre\-sales engagements through product demonstrations, discovery workshops, solution presentations, and client discussions.
 



 • Work with Sales teams to prepare solution proposals, RFP responses, and client presentations.
 



 • Conduct business process analysis and recommend improvements to lending and underwriting workflows.
 



 • Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to define functional requirements and contribute to new product capabilities.
 



 • Support client implementation, UAT, go\-live, and post\-implementation optimization.
 



 • Prepare functional documentation, including solution design documents, business requirements, user stories, and configuration specifications.
 



 • Stay updated on lending regulations, underwriting best practices, and industry trends.
 



  





**Desired Profile** 




  





 • 3–7 years of experience in banking, NBFCs, fintech, credit bureaus, lending technology, or consulting.
 



 • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
 



 • MBA preferred, but not mandatory.
 



 • Strong understanding of lending operations, credit underwriting, and credit policy.
 



 • Experience translating credit policies into decision rules, underwriting workflows, or business rule configurations.
 



 • Prior exposure to Business Rules Engines (BRE), decisioning platforms, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), or workflow engines is highly desirable.
 



 • Experience in solution consulting, business analysis, implementation consulting, or pre\-sales.
 



 • Comfortable conducting client workshops, product demonstrations, and executive presentations.
 



 • Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technology solutions.
 



 • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
 



 • Ability to manage multiple client engagements in a fast\-paced environment.
 



  





**Preferred Experience** 




  





 Candidates with experience in one or more of the following will be preferred:
 



  





 • Lending operations or credit underwriting
 



 • Credit policy design and implementation
 



 • Business Rules Engines (BRE) or decisioning platforms
 



 • Loan Origination Systems (LOS)
 



 • Credit bureaus or credit analytics
 



 • Lending transformation or consulting projects
 



 • Business Analysis or Functional Consulting

2c0749a1.title: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud/Hybris Developer
2c0749a1.description:
Why Valtech? We’re advisors, visionaries, creative and techies. We embrace all things digital. We talk to each other. We have fun. We love our clients. We’re looking ahead • We are global


  
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company \- a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values\-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.


**The opportunity**



At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.



We are proud of:


* The work we do and the innovation we drive
* Our values of share, care and dare
* A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
* Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

  


**The role**



As a **SAP Commerce Cloud Developer ,** you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring **4\-6\+ YEARS** of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.



You will thrive in this role if you are:


* A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
* A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge\-sharing
* Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
* Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)


**Job Summary**



We are seeking an experienced SAP Commerce Cloud Developer/Consultant to join our digital team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining our e\-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2\). You will work closely with cross\-functional teams, business stakeholders, and integration partners to deliver scalable, high\-performance B2B/B2C commerce solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**



Development \& Customization: Develop, customize, and extend SAP Commerce Cloud applications using Java, Spring Framework, and SAP\-specific extensions.



Headless Commerce: Build and maintain headless storefronts using Spartacus (Angular/TypeScript) and integrate them via REST/OData APIs.



Data \& Configuration: Write and maintain complex Impex scripts, FlexibleSearch queries, and manage Backoffice configurations.



Integrations: Design and implement integrations between SAP Commerce Cloud and backend systems (SAP S/4HANA, SAP ERP, SAP CI/CPI, OMS, Payment Gateways, PIM).



Cloud Management: Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot applications in the SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2\) environment using the Merchant Center / Cloud Portal and HAC.



Agile Collaboration: Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and QA teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.



Code Quality: Conduct peer code reviews, write unit tests, and ensure adherence to SAP best practices and coding standards.



Support \& Optimization: Provide L3 support, perform performance tuning, and troubleshoot complex production issues.


**Required Qualifications:**



Experience: \[4\-6\+] years of hands\-on experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development and implementation.



Core Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in Java (J2EE), Spring Framework, Hibernate, and object\-oriented design.



SAP Commerce Expertise: Deep understanding of SAP Commerce data models, extension framework, Impex, FlexibleSearch, Backoffice, and WCMS (SmartEdit).



Accelerators: Experience working with SAP Commerce B2B and/or B2C Accelerators.



Frontend / Headless: Solid experience with Spartacus (Angular) or traditional SAP Commerce frontend (JSP/Tag files, AngularJS).



Integration Skills: Experience with RESTful APIs, SOAP, OData, and integration middleware (SAP Cloud Integration / CPI is a strong plus).



Database: Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases (e.g., SAP HANA, MySQL, Oracle).



Methodology: Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.



Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)



Certifications: SAP Certified Development Professional – SAP Commerce Cloud Developer.



Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with the broader SAP Customer Experience (CX) suite, including SAP CPQ, SAP Emarsys, or SAP Service Cloud.



CI/CD: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, Jenkins, and Cloud Foundry.



Domain Experience: Previous experience in the \[Retail / Manufacturing / Wholesale / etc.] industry.

  


**If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.**

  


**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people**



We design experiences that work for all kinds of people \- and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity \& Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

  




**The benefits**



This is a **\[Fulltime]** position based in **\[Bangalore]**.



Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:


* Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country\-dependent)
* Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
* Learning and development, with access to cutting\-edge tools, training and industry experts


Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

  


**Your application process**



Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.


* ️ Beware of recruitment fraud! Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in **@valtech.com**.



We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

  


**About Valtech**



Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.



At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P\&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.



At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.



Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
  
  

At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting\-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
  
  

We are looking forward to hire Reltio MDM Professionals in the following areas :
  
  

**Job Title:** Reltio Architect – Reltio MDM
  
  

Role Overview
  
We're looking for an experienced Reltio Architect to lead the design and architecture of enterprise Master Data Management solutions on the Reltio platform. You'll define the technical strategy, data architecture, and integration framework that ensures scalable, secure, and high\-quality master data across the organization, while guiding development teams and engaging directly with business and technology stakeholders.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Lead end\-to\-end architecture and design of Reltio MDM solutions, including data models, entity relationships, hierarchies, and reference data structures.
  
Define and govern match \& merge strategies, survivorship rules, and data quality frameworks aligned to business requirements.
  
Architect integration patterns (real\-time, batch, event\-driven) between Reltio and enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, data lakes, and downstream analytics platforms.
  
Establish best practices for API design, Reltio Integration Hub (RIH) usage, and middleware integration (MuleSoft, Kafka, Informatica etc.).
  
Own the technical roadmap for Reltio implementations, including scalability, performance, security, and disaster recovery considerations.
  
Provide architectural oversight and hands\-on guidance to developers and consultants throughout implementation, ensuring adherence to design standards.
  
Collaborate with data governance, security, and compliance teams to ensure MDM solutions meet regulatory and privacy requirements (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.).
  
Conduct architecture reviews, technical risk assessments, and solution audits across Reltio environments.
  
Engage with business stakeholders to translate data strategy and governance goals into scalable technical solutions.
  
Evaluate new Reltio features, tools, and industry trends to continuously improve MDM architecture and capabilities.
  
Define and enforce environment management, deployment, and release strategies (DevOps/CI\-CD) for Reltio solutions.
  
Produce architecture documentation, including solution blueprints, data flow diagrams, and integration specifications.
  
Assess and recommend the right MDM platform/approach (Reltio vs. other tools) for specific use cases when supporting multi\-vendor or hybrid MDM landscapes.
  
Support migration or coexistence strategies when organizations transition from legacy MDM platforms to Reltio.
  
  

Required Skills \& Experience
  
  

10\+ years of MDM experience, with at least 4\+ years specifically architecting Reltio solutions.
  
**Deep expertise in Reltio core architecture:** data modeling, match \& merge, survivorship, hierarchy management, and workflow engine.
  
Strong experience designing integration architectures using REST APIs, RIH, Kafka, and middleware/ETL platforms.
  
Solid understanding of data governance frameworks, data quality management, and enterprise data strategy.
  
Proven experience leading technical teams and mentoring developers/consultants on Reltio best practices.
  
Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud\-native integration patterns.
  
Experience with scripting (Groovy, JavaScript, Python) for custom Reltio configurations.
  
Strong SQL and data modeling skills across relational and NoSQL systems.
  
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences.
  
Working knowledge of other MDM platforms such as Informatica MDM SAAS (Customer 360/MDM Hub), Stibo Systems STEP, Profisee, Semarchy \- including data modeling, match/merge, and governance approaches across these tools.
  
Ability to compare and contrast MDM platform capabilities to advise on tool selection, migration feasibility, or coexistence strategies.
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

Reltio certification(s), particularly at an advanced/architect level.
  
Certification(s) or formal training in at least one other MDM platform (e.g., Informatica MDM, Semarchy, Stibo STEP).
  
Experience architecting MDM solutions in Manufacturing, healthcare, retail, or financial services.
  
Familiarity with enterprise data architecture frameworks.
  
Experience with data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA) in the context of master data.
  
Prior experience in a pre\-sales or solution architecture role within a consulting environment.
  
Hands\-on experience leading or contributing to MDM platform migrations (e.g., legacy tool to Reltio, or multi\-domain MDM consolidation projects).
  
  

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career\-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.
  
  

Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles
  
  

Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
  
Agile self\-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
  
All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
  
Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

5bc602c3.description:
**Job Description – Junior Solution Engineer**
**Job Title:** 
 Junior Solution Engineer
   

  

**Experience:** 
 1–5 Years
   

  

**Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore, Mumbai, Chennai, Pune, Hyderabad, Delhi, Gurugram (Hybrid/Work From Office depending on business requirements)
   

  

**Salary:** 
 ₹8–22 LPA
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a motivated and technically skilled
 **Junior Solution Engineer** 
 to join our growing engineering team. The ideal candidate should have experience working with APIs, cloud platforms, SQL databases, and customer\-focused technical solutions. You will collaborate with product, engineering, and customer success teams to design, implement, and support scalable technology solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Design, develop, and integrate REST APIs with internal and third\-party applications.
* Support cloud\-based deployments and application integrations.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and provide timely resolutions.
* Work closely with development teams during implementation and testing.
* Create technical documentation, solution diagrams, and deployment guides.
* Optimize SQL queries and maintain database performance.
* Assist customers during onboarding, implementation, and post\-deployment support.
* Participate in product demonstrations and technical discussions.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry best practices.


**Required Skills**
* Strong understanding of REST APIs and API integrations.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Familiarity with JSON, XML, and web services.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts, authentication, and security.
* Knowledge of Git and version control systems.
* Experience with Postman or similar API testing tools.
* Good analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Preferred Skills**
* Exposure to Docker or Kubernetes.
* Basic scripting knowledge using Python, Bash, or JavaScript.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of microservices architecture.
* Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools.
* Knowledge of Linux environments.


 Educational Qualification
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications in Cloud, APIs, or SQL are an added advantage.


 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive salary package (₹8–22 LPA).
* Performance\-based bonuses and annual appraisals.
* Health insurance and employee wellness benefits.
* Learning and certification reimbursement.
* Opportunity to work on cloud\-native and enterprise\-scale solutions.
* Collaborative work environment with experienced mentors.
* Career growth and internal mobility opportunities.


**Preferred Candidate Profile**
* 1–5 years of experience in Solution Engineering, Technical Support Engineering, Integration Engineering, or similar roles.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset and customer\-first approach.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving business needs.
* Available to join within 30–60 days is preferred.


 Skills: apis,cloud,sql

3926d76b.title: Senior Test Architect
3926d76b.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

* Test Architect to design, implement, and oversee test strategies, frameworks, and solutions across multiple projects.
* The Test Architect will define the overall testing approach, ensure quality standards, mentor QA teams, and collaborate with stakeholders to deliver reliable and scalable software systems.
* Should have strong knowledge and experience in banking, financial domain and FOREX trading.

  

Skills/Key Responsibilities
  

* Minimum 12 years of experience in Test Architecture with handling of 3 to 4 complex annual releases.
* Minimum 6 years of experience in banking and financial services (BFSI) domain.
* Experience in define and establish test architecture, strategies, and frameworks for enterprise\-level applications "running in an on\-prem data center" and cloud platform.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate tools, technologies, and automation frameworks.
* Design and implement scalable test automation solutions for functional, performance, and regression testing.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and QA teams to ensure quality throughout the SDLC.
* Establish best practices for test design, execution, defect management, and reporting.
* Review and improve testing requirements, test documentation, coverage, and traceability.
* Monitor emerging industry trends and technologies to continuously improve testing processes.
* Strong expertise in test automation tools and performance testing tools
* Experience in IT Infrastructure and Business Test strategy and Detailed Test Plan designing.
* Experience in RTGS application integration testing with Core banking systems (SWIFT, FED (PayPlus) and SIC (GMPlus) RTGS applications and RTGS message testing)
* Should have knowledge in security testing NIDS, HIDS monitoring and Cryptographic Settings, Access Controls, Identification and Authentication, Security Alerting and Audit Controls, Security Standards and Design Compliance.
* Hands\-on experience with Service Management and maintenance tools (IWS , CRaaS, RO tools,Tivoli Monitoring Framework or ScienceLogic, Netcool, Defect Management tools)
Your Future at Kyndryl
  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

Who You Are
  

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  

  

Required Skills and Experience
  

* 12\-15 years of testing experience in aligned technology or service domain
* Experience with test strategy and planning, execution, and defect management and Test Architect
* Proficiency in programming languages and testing tools
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across project teams

  

Preferred Skills and Experience
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
* ISTQB Certification (International Software Testing Qualification Board)
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

+ Design integrated Technology Managed Services solutions across applications, cloud, data, platforms, and service operations
+ Define scope, service catalogue, operating model, delivery model, governance, and continuous improvement approach
+ Incorporate automation, AI/GenAI, and platform\-led efficiencies into the solution
+ Ensure solution decisions are grounded in delivery feasibility, available data, and market competitiveness

* Articulation and client engagement
+ Actively participate in the Articulate phase of pursuits, contributing to proposal development, solution documentation, and oral presentations
+ Structure and communicate the solution across five dimensions: Client context, Design intent, Service operating model, Transition and stabilization approach and Value realization
+ Support or lead solution walkthroughs, workshops, and client discussions, ensuring clarity and confidence in the proposed model
+ Partner with Sales and deal leadership to ensure the client narrative and solution design remain aligned

* Transition, stabilization, and delivery model design
+ Design transition and onboarding strategies, including knowledge transfer, phased migration, and stabilization
+ Define early\-stage risk mitigation levers such as SWAT teams, command centre, and backlog reduction
+ Ensure transition plans are practical, sequenced, and aligned to client readiness
+ Support delivery teams in mobilization and early lifecycle stages

* Estimation and commercial input
+ Translate solution design into effort drivers, staffing models, and productivity assumptions
+ Work closely with Pricing teams to ensure commercial models reflect solution realities
+ Validate alignment between service commitments, SLAs, and cost structures
+ Highlight risks, contingencies, and dependencies that impact commercial viability

* Solution assurance and risk management
+ Identify and address risks across scope, delivery, transition, tooling, and governance
+ Ensure solution integrity across proposal content, pricing assumptions, and client messaging
+ Participate in solution reviews, challenge sessions, and leadership governance forums
+ Maintain clarity on assumptions, exclusions, and dependencies to avoid downstream risk


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Ability to translate complex managed services solutions into clear, client\-relevant narratives
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end Managed Services lifecycle (pursuit to steady state)
* Experience aligning delivery reality with client\-facing messaging
* Structured thinking with the ability to connect business outcomes, service design, and commercial models
* Confidence to engage and influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Delivery, and domain teams
* Strong collaboration skills to work across global, multi\-disciplinary pursuit teams
* Comfort operating in ambiguous, multi\-owner environments and driving alignment


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 10\+ years of experience in Technology Managed Services, Application Management, or TechOps
* Proven experience in solutioning and/or leading complex managed services pursuits
* Hands\-on experience in one or more areas:
+ Enterprise applications (SAP, ServiceNow, MS Dynamics, Guidewire, etc.)
+ Cloud and platform operations
+ Data and analytics platforms
+ Service management and ITSM environments (e.g., ServiceNow)

* Experience working across multi\-tower or integrated managed services deals
* Strong exposure to transition, service delivery, and operating model design


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience participating in or leading solution articulation, proposals, or orals
* Understanding of integrated business and technology managed services models
* Familiarity with commercial constructs and pricing drivers in managed services
* Exposure to design thinking, structured problem solving, or agile ways of working
* Architecture or service management certifications (e.g., TOGAF, ITIL)


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the you may aspire to become.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

41e1d996.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
41e1d996.description:
**About Kaseya**
 Kaseya is the leading provider of AI\-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long\-term business success.
   

  

 Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double\-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
   

  

 Founded in 2000, Kaseya has built a culture centered around innovation, accountability, and results. We are a high\-growth, high\-performance organization that values individuals who are driven, adaptable, and committed to delivering exceptional outcomes for our customers and teammates alike.
   

  

 At Kaseya, success comes from embracing challenges, moving with urgency, and continuously raising the bar.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Kaseya is looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to lead high\-impact, cross\-platform technical programs that span multiple SaaS products, engineering organizations, and business functions. In this role, you will operate as a force multiplier for engineering and product leadership, driving execution rigor, dependency management, and delivery predictability across complex initiatives such as platform integrations, modernization efforts, reliability improvements, and enterprise\-scale launches. This role requires strong technical depth, systems thinking, executive communication, and the ability to influence across a highly matrixed organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Program Leadership \& Delivery
   

  

* Own and drive end\-to\-end execution of large, cross\-functional technical programs impacting multiple Kaseya products and platforms
* Translate company\-level priorities into clear program plans, milestones, success metrics, and delivery commitments
* Actively manage scope, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, and operations teams
* Ensure programs are delivered with high quality, security, and reliability standards appropriate for MSP and enterprise customers


 Technical \& Architectural Partnership
   

  

* Partner closely with engineering leaders and architects to understand system design, platform constraints, and technical risks
* Drive alignment on architecture decisions, sequencing, and integration strategies, especially across acquired products
* Develop technical fluency across Kaseya's SaaS platforms, APIs, data flows, and cloud infrastructure


 Stakeholder \& Executive Communication
   

  

* Serve as the single\-threaded owner for program health, communicating clearly with senior engineering, product, and executive leaders
* Produce crisp executive\-level updates that highlight progress, risks, mitigation plans, and decision points
* Facilitate decision\-making across organizations with competing priorities and limited resources


 Operational Excellence \& Scale
   

  

* Establish scalable program management frameworks, operating rhythms, and tooling to support Kaseya's growth
* Identify systemic execution gaps and drive improvements in planning, dependency management, and delivery predictability
* Mentor and influence other TPMs, helping raise the bar for technical program management across the organization


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Engineering Program Management, or equivalent roles in SaaS or cloud\-based software environments
* Strong technical foundation with the ability to engage deeply in architecture, APIs, data, and cloud\-native systems
* Proven experience leading multi\-team, multi\-product programs with significant technical and organizational complexity
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority in a fast\-paced, matrixed organization


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working on platform integration, M\&A integration, or large\-scale SaaS modernization initiatives
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), distributed systems, and enterprise\-grade security requirements
* Experience supporting B2B, IT management, security, or MSP\-focused products
* Strong working knowledge of Agile and hybrid delivery models
* Prior experience mentoring TPMs or acting as a program leader across multiple initiatives


**Additional Information**
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

e52d821e.description:
**About the Role** 





 We're looking for a Cybersecurity Pre\-Sales Engineer to bridge the gap between our security solutions and client requirements. You'll work closely with sales teams to understand customer pain points, design tailored security solutions, and drive technical wins throughout the sales cycle.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 



* Partner with the sales team to understand prospect requirements and translate them into technical solution designs
* Deliver product demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts (PoCs), and technical presentations to prospective clients
* Respond to RFPs/RFIs with accurate technical and solution content
* Design and propose cybersecurity solutions (endpoint security, SIEM/SOC, cloud security, identity/access management, data protection, GRC, etc., as applicable)
* Conduct technical discovery calls to assess client security posture and requirements
* Build and maintain relationships with technical stakeholders on the client side
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to relay customer feedback and market requirements
* Prepare solution architecture, sizing, and cost estimates
* Support post\-sales handoff to ensure smooth implementation
* Stay current on cybersecurity trends, threat landscape, and competitive products



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field
* 3–4 years of experience in cybersecurity pre\-sales, solutions engineering, or a related technical role
* Solid understanding of core security domains: endpoint protection, SIEM/SOC, cloud security, IAM, data protection, or GRC
* Familiarity with security frameworks and standards (ISO 27001, NIST, MITRE ATT\&CK, etc.)
* Strong presentation and communication skills; comfortable engaging with both technical and business stakeholders
* Hands\-on experience or working knowledge of security tools/platforms (EDR/XDR, SIEM, DLP, IAM, cloud security tools — adjust to your product stack)
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value for clients
* Experience responding to RFPs and creating technical proposals



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Certifications such as CEH, Security\+, or vendor\-specific certifications
* Prior experience in a pre\-sales/solutions engineering role at a cybersecurity vendor, MSSP, or systems integrator
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud security tools

49770518.title: Architect - Infra
49770518.description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
   

  

 Gathers customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. Identifies and evaluates industry trends (customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry). Adapts business models, plans, and solutions to insights.
   

  

 Works with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution. Where the cost of change is accepted by the customer, shares this feedback with the project team and the broader account team to make the necessary adjustments using mechanisms such as updating the solution approach and projected costs in presales and change requests in delivery. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and shares insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services, and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.
   

  

 Architecture Design and Deployment
   

  

 Leverages a structured approach to Architecture Projects using existing methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Iterative) that make use of existing reference architecture and established architectural styles and design patterns. Proposes and develops new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood. 
   

  

 Defines and documents the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Leads complex cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the Architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Uses a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Project Manager to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots, using enterprise architecture processes and ensuring quality control through peer review. Works with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realize.
   

  

 Works with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Manages and resolves complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Maintains the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Drives development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer. Where there are defects, works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Customer to redress or accept and document the status of the test results. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex Solution Approach with traceability of requirements, constraints, decisions, and tradeoffs that balances risk, technical credibility, and technical innovation to meet customer need, predominantly based on existing solution offerings and/or reference architecture. Jointly leads the implementation in close partnership with the Project Manager. Leads oversight and governance and establishment of quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Uses a cohesive build methodology with an agreed release schedule and timeline so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Works with the Project Manager to highlight where assumptions have proven false. Uses change requests to modify the Solution/project approach when needed. As needed, collaborates with subject matter experts to receive specialized advice that can help define the Solution and project approach and increase the time to value for the customer.
   

  

 Anticipates and identifies scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with account/project team to resolve non\-technical issues. Reports significant problems to Microsoft management and resolves escalations when needed. Plans a way forward in complex and ambiguous situations with an innovative approach and durable design. Delegates and leverages specialist skills of others to drive technical alignment across internal/external teams. Coordinates disparate approaches into a single plan of action for complex scenarios.  
   

  

 Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. 
   

  

 Practice Development
   

  

 Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities. 
   

  

 Trusted Advisor
   

  

 Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the **Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report**. We named a Leader in the **Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026** and **Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026**.

The ITSM Process Consultant is responsible for designing, assessing, improving, and governing IT service management processes that support reliable, efficient, and business\-aligned service delivery. This role works closely with IT leadership, service owners, support teams, platform administrators, and business stakeholders to define process standards, drive ITIL\-aligned practices, improve operational performance, and enable continual service improvement. The consultant translates business and operational requirements into practical process frameworks, workflows, controls, metrics, and documentation across core ITSM disciplines such as Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalog, Asset, Configuration, and Release Management.

 **What You Will Do**

* Develop and maintain process documentation (policies, workflows, SOPs, RACI, governance models)

 **What You Will Bring**

* Strong expertise in ITIL framework and ITSM lifecycle processes
  
* Proven experience in designing and improving ITSM processes in enterprise environments
  
* Hands\-on experience with ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Remedy, Jira Service Management, etc.)
  
* Strong knowledge of process metrics, dashboards, SLA frameworks, and reporting
  
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical process frameworks and workflows
  
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and process\-mapping capabilities
  
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams (IT, business, operations, vendors)
  
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and facilitation skills
  
* Understanding of governance, compliance standards (ITIL, ISO 20000\), and audit readiness

 **Benefits:**

* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
  
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
