8e24c12d.title: Cloud Architect(Multi-Cloud)
8e24c12d.description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Cloud Architect(Multi\-Cloud)
   

  

**About Your Role**
 As a Cloud Solution Architect, you will design and evolve complex systems that support critical products and services. You will collaborate with architecture, product, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and delivery teams to define system patterns, improve reliability, and drive modernization. Your work will help ensure our platforms are secure, scalable, and resilient so we can deliver compelling experiences for our clients and their customers.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end systems engineering for highly available, large\-scale platforms, including requirements analysis, design, implementation guidance, and operational readiness.
* Define and document system patterns, integration standards, and reference architectures that align with enterprise standards and technology roadmaps.
* Analyze performance, scalability, and resiliency characteristics of complex systems and drive improvements through design changes and optimization.
* Partner with product management and engineering teams to translate business and functional requirements into technical system designs and implementation plans.
* Evaluate and recommend tools, technologies, and platforms for observability, automation, configuration management, and infrastructure orchestration.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers on systems design, reliability engineering, and best practices for secure, compliant operations.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure designs meet security, compliance, and privacy requirements and to remediate identified risks in system designs.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You'll Need To Have**
* 12\+ years of experience in systems engineering or infrastructure engineering designing, implementing, and supporting large\-scale, distributed systems in enterprise environments.
* Experience with modern infrastructure technologies such as Linux or Windows server platforms, virtualization, and cloud or hybrid environments.
* Experience with scripting or programming (for example, Python or similar language) to automate system tasks, configuration, or deployments.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (for example, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Datadog, or similar) to ensure system reliability and performance.
* Experience with configuration management or infrastructure\-as\-code tools (for example, Ansible, Terraform, or similar) or equivalent approaches to automation.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.


**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**
* Experience designing or operating systems in public cloud environments such as Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience in the payments, financial services, or fintech domain, including knowledge of regulatory and security standards such as PCI.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with reliability\-focused practices such as site reliability engineering (SRE), chaos engineering, or capacity planning.


**How You'll Work**
* This role is on\-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in\-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in\-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.


**Benefits At Fiserv**
* Fuel Your Life program to support your physical, financial, social, and emotional well\-being.
* Paid holidays and generous time away policies.
* No\-cost mental health support through Employee Assistance Programs.
* Living Proof program to recognize your peers’ extra effort with points redeemable for rewards.
* Eight Employee Resource Groups to foster a collaborative culture and expand your network.
* Unparalleled professional growth with training, development, and internal mobility opportunities.


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
   

  

**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

8c6bdd2a.title: Delivery Lead - IND
8c6bdd2a.description:
About Kinaxis:
**About Kinaxis**


Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!  

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.  

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
About the team:
**Location**


Chennai/Bangalore

**About the team**


Kinaxis is looking for a Delivery Lead with proven success in managing mid\-scale programs and projects for global enterprise customers. You will have the opportunity to bring your in\-depth knowledge of supply chain, technical expertise and project management abilities to delivery Maestro solution on time and on budget.


About the role:
**What you will do**

* Participate in deep\-dive customer business requirements discovery sessions and in developing required specifications documentation.
* Independently manages delivery of mid\-sized workstreams using well\-defined delivery standards and protocols. Leads small cross\-functional teams, delegates tasks, and supports workstream planning, budgeting, and client communications under guidance from Manager.
* Makes tactical decisions within workstream scope, escalating strategic issues.
* Leads communication for assigned workstreams. Manages expectations, delivers updates, and resolves minor issues. Works closely with Delivery Managers and clients to align expectations and delivery.
* Supports project workstream planning and cross\-functional coordination to meet project timelines and budgets. Suggests delivery improvements and evaluates identified risks for mitigation.
* Translates client requirements into actionable tasks for technical teams, flags issues, and applies general industry knowledge to support client context.
* Participate in documentation of solutions deployed in guidance with Solution Architects.
* Guide and mentor fellow consultants in project teams by sharing information of successful resolutions and risk mitigations.
* Living Kinaxis India’s core values of being empowered and stronger together, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the organization.
* There may be opportunities available to travel

 **What we are looking for**

* Minimum 3\-7 years Supply Chain industry experience, managing mid scale implementations in software consulting services.
* Good Technical Project Management expertise, with at least 2 years demonstrated history of implementing complex software solutions.
* Previous history delivering on multi\-phase projects, rolled out over a period of 2\+ years for Enterprise clients.
* Able to travel 50\-75% of the time, both within India and outside.
* Ability to effectively communicate with all levels within the organization, including C\-level Executives.
* Willingness to provide both a big picture view of client engagement as well as take a “roll up your sleeves” attitude towards project delivery.
* College/University degree \- Business, Supply Chain, computer science, process engineering preferred.
* Previous experience working in a Management Consulting environment.
* Experience with advanced planning solutions such as Kinaxis, SAP, JDA, etc.
* Delivering projects and programs with a global focus for external clients.

  



Why join Kinaxis?:
**Work With Impact:** Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P\&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long\-term net\-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

*People matter* at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide days off)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well\-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs, training, and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons


For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com.


Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

*Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.*

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


Technical Program Managers in the Product/Project Management (Technical) stream are responsible for leading the development, implementation, and management of engineering projects and systems. This role involves collaborating with cross\-functional teams to achieve project goals, ensuring alignment with business objectives, and overseeing the creation of requirements, functional specifications, database design, and technical architecture. Technical Program Managers utilize project management tools to plan, execute, monitor, and control projects, effectively managing resources, budgets, timelines, and quality. The position emphasizes stakeholder collaboration to drive successful outcomes in engineering and operational projects, fostering an inclusive and innovative environment.

  

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.  

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead cross\-functional teams to achieve project goals and ensure alignment with business objectives.
* Define requirements, create functional specifications, and oversee database design and technical architecture.
* Utilize project management tools to plan, execute, monitor, and control projects.
* Manage resources, budgets, timelines, and quality for engineering and operational projects.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to drive successful outcomes and foster innovation.
* Oversee the technology development lifecycle, ensuring timely delivery of high\-quality features and enhancements.
* Define and track key performance metrics to measure success and drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure products comply with relevant regulations and security standards.
* Coach engineering teams on Agile/Scrum/Lean principles and practices.


This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

**Qualifications**


Basic Qualifications:

* 10\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or with an advanced degree.
* Experience in developing and maintaining technology product roadmaps.
* Experience in writing user stories and grooming product backlogs.
* Experience in coordinating and prioritizing conflicting requirements in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment.
* Experience in working in an agile environment.
* Experience in providing technical guidance and leadership to engineering teams.
* Experience in managing resources, budgets, timelines, and quality for engineering projects.
* Experience in defining and tracking key performance metrics.
* Experience in ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and security standards.
* Experience in coaching teams on Agile/Scrum/Lean principles and practices.

  

Preferred Qualifications:

* 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or with an advanced degree
* Experience in loyalty functions including rewards programs, offer management, partnership management, customer engagement, integration with e\-commerce platforms, communication and outreach, analytics and reporting, and travel portal buildout.
* Experience in developing roadmaps and leading technical integration of product offerings.
* Experience in gathering and analyzing client feedback to inform product enhancements.
* Experience in creating data\-driven business solutions using a wide variety of technologies.
* Experience in leading and organizing events supporting innovation within the sub\-function.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.


When a production cloud incident hits a Tier 1 financial firm at 2 a.m., someone senior has to own it. As AVP, Cloud Support Engineer, you're that person — the senior escalation point for LPL's run\-the\-cloud function, taking the hardest tickets and incidents end\-to\-end and turning recurring toil into automated, self\-service paths. If you want to operate AWS at scale with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.

**Job Overview:**
-----------------


As the AVP, Cloud Support Engineer, you are a hands\-on senior cloud operations engineer in the Support team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) — the run\-the\-cloud function for LPL's AWS multi\-account landing zone. You are the senior escalation point for the Support team's 24x7 Tier 1 / Tier 2 queue: you take the hardest tickets and production incidents end\-to\-end, own operational excellence, and decide when to pull in the Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, or Delivery. You partner closely with the Monitoring pod within Foundations on alerting and runbooks. LPL is an AWS\-first CCOE: a multi\-account landing zone with 100\+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60\+ AWS services, delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands\-on in troubleshooting, runbooks, Terraform, and incident response — and you continuously turn repeatable requests into automated, self\-service paths — across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC).

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Operate as a hands\-on senior cloud support engineer: spend the majority of your time in production troubleshooting, runbook authoring and execution, Terraform changes, complex ticket resolution, and incident response — hands\-on operations is the primary leverage point
* Serve as the senior escalation point for the Support team's Tier 1 / Tier 2 queue: take the hardest tickets and production incidents end\-to\-end, and decide when to pull in the Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, or Delivery. Turn recurring toil into durable fixes: convert repeatable account / IAM / access requests and incident classes into self\-service paths through the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) and the private Terraform module library
* Own operational excellence for the run\-the\-cloud function: runbook quality, change\-management discipline in ServiceNow, post\-incident reviews, and SLA / operational metrics; partner with the Monitoring pod within Foundations to close monitoring and alerting gaps. Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self\-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities to raise the run\-the\-cloud bar: AI\-assisted triage and root\-cause analysis, MCP\-driven conversational self\-service for common requests, automated runbook generation, and on\-call copilots that summarize telemetry and chat during incidents
* Personally participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations as a senior technical responder and escalation point for production incidents. Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to align roadmaps and remove cross\-team and cross\-pod blockers
* Raise engineering quality across the pod through code review, design partnership, and technical pairing — acting as a force multiplier without direct reports. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) and partner with the RTE and PMO on delivery commitments and dependencies

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 12\+ years of progressive technical experience including 5\+ years in a senior cloud security, network security, or cloud infrastructure engineering role; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 5\+ years of hands\-on production AWS at scale in a multi\-account landing zone with strong production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions
* Demonstrated experience operating as a senior individual contributor (AVP, Senior Engineer, Staff Engineer, or equivalent), influencing technical direction and uplifting peer engineers without direct authority — including code review leadership, design\-review participation, and technical mentorship
* Experience personally participating in 24x7 production on\-call rotations in a fast\-paced, security\-conscious, regulated environment (financial services strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated experience as a senior engineer on a production cloud operations / support function: leading incident response as an escalation point, owning change management (ServiceNow or comparable ITSM), and driving runbook and automation improvements that reduce toil

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* Player\-coach who is comfortable in code reviews, architecture sessions, and people 1:1s in the same day. Continuous learner, especially in cloud\-native, IaC, platform engineering, and applied AI
* Sets vision and translates ambiguous strategy into executable engineering roadmaps. Bias for self\-service, automation, and reducing toil for downstream internal customers
* Builds high\-trust relationships across the US and India organization and across functions (Architecture, Security, FinOps, Application Engineering, Network, Audit). Calm, decisive incident commander; fosters a strong post\-incident learning culture
* Excellent written and verbal communication, executive presence, and ability to influence without direct authority. Thrives in matrixed, fast\-paced, regulated environments with imperfect information

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or MBA. Experience building, scaling, or leading globally distributed engineering teams across the US and India / GCC
* Experience integrating agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) into platform, IaC, and engineering practice. Strong scripting / programming proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* AWS Solutions Architect \- Professional. AWS Certified Generative AI Developer \- Associate. Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\) or Authoring \& Operations. Open\-source contributions, public technical writing, or conference speaking on cloud, IaC, or platform engineering topics
* Experience with Backstage or another Internal Developer Platform (IDP). Experience with FinOps practices and cloud cost management at scale

201d08e3.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.


VP, PMO


LPL Financial

***Lead with Purpose, Unlock Your Team’s Passion***


At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience — shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win – clients, LPL, and most importantly our, employees.


If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what’s possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today.


Big cloud programs live or die on coordination — and LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence runs a lot of them across two continents. As VP, PMO, you'll lead the CCOE program\-management function and the India\-based team of project managers and scrum masters who keep delivery moving across the five CCOE teams. If you're a people\-first delivery leader who can turn a portfolio of overseas work into predictable outcomes, this is your seat.

**Job Overview:**
-----------------


As the VP, PMO, you lead the program\-management function for LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) and manage the team of project managers and scrum masters — primarily based in the India Global Capability Center (GCC) — who support the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery). You are the single point of accountability for coordinating CCOE projects and tasks executed in the India GCC, and you drive intake, prioritization, milestone tracking, and risk / dependency management across the portfolio. You partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on program\-level cadence and with the VPs leading the CCOE teams to align commitments and balance capacity across LPL's US offices and India. This is a people\-leadership and delivery role — not an engineering or on\-call role — focused on growing a high\-performing PMO and making CCOE delivery predictable.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Build and grow the India\-based PMO as a high\-performing, cohesive team that the CCOE teams trust to run their projects — the delivery backbone for work executed overseas
* Champion agentic AI in program management: AI\-assisted status synthesis and executive reporting, automated risk and dependency surfacing from Jira, and meeting\-notes\-to\-action items — modeling AI\-forward delivery for the PMO team
* Lead the CCOE program\-management function: manage a team of project managers and scrum masters supporting the five CCOE teams across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC)
* Own all people\-management responsibilities for the PMO team: hiring, onboarding, weekly 1:1s, performance management, career development, and capacity planning
* Serve as the single point of accountability for coordinating CCOE projects and tasks executed in the India GCC — planning, sequencing, and reporting status across overseas delivery
* Drive program and project delivery across the CCOE portfolio: intake, prioritization, milestone tracking, and risk / issue / dependency management with clear executive status
* Partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on program\-level cadence: program increment planning, release\-train events, and portfolio reporting
* Standardize PMO practice across CCOE: Jira and Confluence hygiene, reporting dashboards, delivery metrics (predictability, throughput, cycle time), and continuous improvement
* Partner with the VPs leading the five CCOE teams and the Foundations pods to align delivery commitments, remove cross\-team blockers, and balance capacity across the US and India

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 10\+ years in program / project management including 4\+ years directly managing a team of project managers and/or scrum masters; Bachelor's degree (or equivalent work experience)
* Demonstrated experience as a people manager — hiring, performance management, and career development — of a delivery / PMO team, preferably including an India GCC / offshore team
* Strong program\-management discipline across a technical portfolio: intake, prioritization, milestone / risk / dependency management, and executive reporting in Jira and Confluence
* Experience partnering with an enterprise EPMO / RTE on program\-level events and portfolio reporting (scaled\-Agile experience preferred)
* Experience coordinating delivery across US and India / GCC time zones in a fast\-paced, regulated environment (financial services preferred)

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* Servant\-leader people manager who grows project managers and scrum masters
* Calm under delivery pressure; drives clarity across many concurrent projects
* Excellent executive communicator who makes portfolio status and risk legible to senior leaders
* Data\-driven on delivery health (predictability, throughput, cycle time) — reports early and honestly
* Skilled at cross\-time\-zone coordination between the US and India / GCC
* Bias for pragmatic process that accelerates delivery, not process for its own sake
* Builds high\-trust relationships across CCOE engineering leadership, the enterprise EPMO, and vendor partners

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or Program Management Professional (PgMP)
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM / PSM) or SAFe (SSM, SPC)
* Master's degree or MBA
* Experience managing program delivery for cloud, infrastructure, or platform\-engineering programs
* Atlassian admin experience across Jira, Jira Advanced Roadmaps, and Confluence
* Experience using agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) for program reporting, status synthesis, and risk surfacing
* Experience building and leading offshore / GCC delivery teams

d85ea43a.title: Technology Program Manager
d85ea43a.description:
**Job Requirements**
 We are seeking an experienced Technology Program Manager to lead complex technology initiatives that support our banking operations and digital transformation goals. The successful candidate will manage large\-scale programs involving multiple technology projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk management standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Management**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex technology programs involving multiple workstreams and cross\-functional teams
* Develop comprehensive program roadmaps, timelines, and resource allocation plans
* Manage program budgets ranging from $5M\-$50M\+ with accountability for ROI and cost optimization
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple projects and technology platforms
* Establish and maintain program governance frameworks, including steering committees and executive reporting


**Stakeholder Management**
* Partner with business leaders, technology teams, and external vendors to drive program success
* Facilitate communication between technical teams and business stakeholders
* Present program status, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership and board committees
* Manage relationships with regulatory bodies and ensure compliance throughout program lifecycle
* Coordinate with Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams to address regulatory requirements


**Risk \& Compliance Management**
* Ensure all technology initiatives comply with banking regulations (SOX, GDPR, PCI\-DSS, etc.)
* Implement robust risk management frameworks and mitigation strategies
* Coordinate security reviews and penetration testing for new systems and processes
* Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit and regulatory examination purposes
* Ensure business continuity and disaster recovery planning for critical systems


**Technology Leadership**
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture teams to ensure technology alignment
* Oversee integration of new systems with existing banking infrastructure
* Drive adoption of modern development practices including DevOps, CI/CD, and cloud technologies
* Ensure scalability, performance, and security standards are met across all deliverables
* Support technology vendor selection and contract negotiations


**Required Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field
* MBA or advanced degree preferred
* 8\+ years of program management experience in financial services or technology
* 5\+ years of experience in banking, fintech, or highly regulated industries
* Demonstrated experience managing programs with budgets exceeding $10M


**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of banking systems (core banking, payment processing, risk management)
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
* Knowledge of modern software development methodologies (Agile, DevOps)
* Understanding of data management, analytics, and reporting platforms
* Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks and practices

9b723db4.title: PRE-SALES (W/M/D)
9b723db4.description:
Bei Quorum bieten wir aufregende Karrieremöglichkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld. Wir suchen nach motivierten und talentierten Personen, die sich unserer Leidenschaft für innovative Technologien und exzellenten Kundenservice anschließen möchten.
   

  

 Wir sind immer auf der Suche nach neuen Talenten!
   

  

 Wir brauchen Verstärkung, daher suchen wir nach einem neuen Teammitglied im Inside Sales.
   

  

 Wir brauchen Verstärkung, daher suchen wir nach einem neuen Teammitglied im PRE\-Sales.
   

  

 Wir sind immer auf der Suche nach neuen Talenten!
   

  

 Wir sind ein führender Distributor von IT\-Hardware und \-Software in Österreich, spezialisiert auf Backup\- und Storage\-Systeme. Unsere Partnerschaften umfassen sowohl lokale als auch internationale Unternehmen und erleichtern den Zugang zum österreichischen Markt.
   

  

 In unserer Rolle als Distributor fungieren wir als Verbindungsglied zwischen Herstellern von Hard\- und Software sowie Fachhandelspartnern. Wir kümmern uns um Angebote, Konzepte, Demos, Bestellungen und Logistik, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Partner die bestmögliche Unterstützung erhalten.
   

  

 Unser Ziel ist es, IT\-Spezialisten dabei zu unterstützen, die optimale Lösung für ihre Kund:innen zu finden.
   

  

 Quorum ist führend im Bereich Datenverfügbarkeit und unterstützt seine Vertriebspartner mit technischem Know\-how und persönlichem Engagement. Dabei setzen wir auf Produkte renommierter Hersteller. Unser Ziel ist es, gemeinsam mit unseren Mitarbeiter:innen kontinuierlich zu wachsen und die Qualität unserer Dienstleistungen stetig zu verbessern.
   

  

 Unsere Philosophie leben wir jeden Tag – mit einem fundierten Wissen und einem wachsenden Netzwerk agieren wir authentisch und zuverlässig. Als fachkundige Teamplayer pflegen wir enge Beziehungen zu unseren Kund:innen, Partnern und Herstellern.
   

  

 Wir betrachten das Geschäft unserer Kund:innen als unser eigenes und unterstützen sie mit unserem professionellen und persönlichen Fachwissen. Bei Quorum stehen Backup, Storage und Datenmanagement im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns.
   

  

 In einem sich kontinuierlich entwickelnden Markt sind wir stets auf der Suche nach neuen Talenten, die unser Team bereichern. In unseren Stellenbeschreibungen findest du alle relevanten Informationen und Details zu den Anforderungen.
   

  

 Wir legen großen Wert darauf, Mitarbeitende zu finden, die zu unserer Unternehmenskultur passen. Wir suchen nach eigenständigen, verantwortungsbewussten Personen, die sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln möchten, motiviert sind und Respekt im Umgang miteinander schätzen.
   

  

 Fehlende fachliche Kompetenzen sollten dich nicht davon abhalten, dich bei uns zu bewerben. Wir legen großen Wert auf Wissensaustausch und bieten die Möglichkeit zur kontinuierlichen Weiterbildung.
   

  

 Bist du bereit für neue Herausforderungen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Initiativbewerbung.

d5530c69.title: Manager, Solution Consulting Operations
d5530c69.description:
**About Highspot** 





 Highspot is a software product development company and a recognized global leader in the sales enablement category, leveraging cutting\-edge AI and GenAI technologies at the core of its robust Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) platform. Highspot is revolutionizing how millions of individuals work worldwide. Through its AI\-powered platform, Highspot drives enterprise transformation to empower sales teams through intelligent content management, training, contextual guidance, customer engagement, meeting intelligence, and actionable analytics. The Highspot platform delivers advanced features tailored to business needs, in a modern design that sales and marketing executives appreciate and is the \#1 rated sales enablement platform on G2 Crowd.
 




  






 While headquartered in Seattle, Highspot has expanded its footprint across America, Canada, the UK, Germany, Australia, and now India, solidifying its presence in the Asia Pacific markets.
 




  





  


**About The Role** 



  



 We are looking for a Solution Consulting Operations Manager to support our sales, solution consulting and account management teams in delivering rapid, quality support to the Global Solution Consulting team. The Solution Consulting Operations Manager reports to the Director of Services, with a dotted\-line to the International SC Leader based in London. 
 



  






  




**Responsibilities** 
  

  
* Buyer Experience. Develop relationships with our internal stakeholders to keep us moving towards a highly efficient experience. Coach the SC Operations team to deliver quality work
  
* Scale Organizations, Processes and Operations. Work with the Services Director and Solution Consulting Leader to design, refine and innovate the service and processes as our company grows and evolves
  
* Report on key metrics to indicate the success of global Solution Consulting programmes
  
* Develop a High Performing, High Engagement Team and Culture. Coach and develop your direct reports. Demonstrate very high emotional intelligence. Set and uphold the highest performance standards. Help colleagues “enjoy the ride” \- one of our core guiding principles
  
* Partner effectively across functions. Act as an ally and partner to colleagues in sister functions \- Product, Account Management, Marketing and others \- making decisions that take broader perspectives into account and providing insight into others’ decisions. Demonstrate a balanced, reasoned approach to conflict or differing priorities
  
* Cultivate deep product knowledge. Gain deep knowledge, understanding, and experience with the Highspot platform and the value it provides businesses
  

  


  


  




**Required Qualifications** 
  

  
* 8 \- 12\+ years of experience in Solution Consulting Operations, Pre\-sales solutioning, Business Operations, or Strategy \& Operations
  
* 2 \- 5 years of leading high performing teams, ideally supporting sales functions
  
* 3\+ years working with SaaS products and technologies
  
* Demonstrated ability to work cross functionally
  
* Familiarity with SaaS businesses, metrics, goals, challenges
  
* Knowledge of technology in the sales tech, CRM or martech space
  
* Knowledge of how businesses and sales teams operate in our target market
  
* Proven strong executive leadership and decision making abilities
  
* Strong communication skills, ability to articulate and sell a vision internally and externally
  
* Strong execution skills and the ability to drive action and accountability
  
* Proven track record of hiring, developing and managing world\-class talent
  
* Experience working with and/or deploying Sales/Marketing/Service technologies
  
* Working knowledge of CRM (Salesforce.com, Dynamics 365\)
  
* Entrepreneurial spirit and mindset, a focus on possibilities and not obstacle
  
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and change
  
* Proven track record of defining and optimizing processes
  
* Strong written and spoken English
  

  


  





  




  


  


  







  




  





  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 





 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, ancestry, citizenship, color, ethnicity, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or invisible disability status, political affiliation, veteran status, race, religion, or sexual orientation.
 




  






 Did you read the requirements as a checklist and not tick every box? Don't rule yourself out! If this role resonates with you, hit the ‘apply’ button.
 



  


 Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in our Hiring Process:
   

 To help our recruiting team review the applications we receive, we use third\-party AI\-assisted tools as one input during early screening. To reduce the risk of bias, identifying details \- including your name and information that could indicate age, race, gender, or disability \- are removed before your resume is analyzed. This tool supports our recruiters; it does not replace them. Our team independently reviews applications, no candidate is rejected solely on the basis of the tool's output, and all hiring decisions are made by people. You may ask for your application to be reviewed without AI\-assisted tools, and you may request a reasonable accommodation at any time. To do either, or to ask how your personal information is processed, contact \[recops@highspot.com]. Making a request will not affect your candidacy.

6380b0a2.title: Solution Architect (Upto 25 LPA)
6380b0a2.description:
**Solution Architect**
**Location:** 
 Hybrid (Surat, Gujarat)
   

  

**Salary Range:** 
 ₹20,00,000 \- ₹25,00,000 per annum
   

  

**Experience:** 
 6\+ Years
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are seeking a skilled and experienced
 **Solution Architect** 
 to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will design end\-to\-end scalable technology solutions, align technical strategies with business objectives, and guide engineering teams in implementing robust system architectures. This position requires a strong combination of technical expertise, solution design capabilities, and stakeholder collaboration skills to drive successful project execution across enterprise and product\-based environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architecture Design: Define and design scalable, secure, and high\-performing system architectures that meet business requirements.
* Technical Strategy Alignment: Collaborate with stakeholders to align technical strategies with business objectives and ensure successful project execution.
* Team Guidance: Lead and guide engineering teams in the implementation of architectural standards and best practices.
* Technology Evaluation: Evaluate and recommend technology stacks that are future\-ready and aligned with industry trends.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive architecture documentation and standards.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment and understanding of architectural decisions.


**Required Skills \& ExperienceCore Technical Skills**
* Experience: 8\+ years of software engineering experience with at least 2\+ years in an Architecture role.
* Architecture Expertise: Strong experience in Solution Architecture, System Design, and Enterprise Architecture.
* System Understanding: Strong understanding of system architecture, solution design, and enterprise application integration.
* Cloud Platforms: Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure cloud architecture.
* Caching Technologies: Experience with caching technologies such as Redis.
* Queue Systems: Experience with queue systems such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, or Service Bus.
* Microservices Knowledge: Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, REST APIs, and distributed systems.
* Database Familiarity: Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and modern backend/application frameworks.
* Optimization Principles: Understanding scalability, security, reliability, and performance optimization principles.


 Functional Strengths
   

  

* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze business problems and design practical, scalable technical solutions.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Security Knowledge: Strong understanding of security architecture, authentication, authorization, and OWASP best practices.
* Agile Experience: Experience working in Agile and cross\-functional development environments.
* Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects and architecture initiatives simultaneously.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications such as TOGAF, AWS, Azure, or Solution Architecture.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.


 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to work in a hybrid environment.
* A collaborative and innovative work culture.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.


 If you are passionate about technology and have a proven track record in solution architecture, we encourage you to apply and join our team in shaping the future of technology solutions.
   

  

 Skills: rabbitmq,solution architecture,owasp,redis,aws,rest apis,azure

0d1a8173.description:
**About the role :**

The Cloud Center of Excellence (COE) is responsible for developing Gartner’s capabilities in automating and streamlining IT infrastructure processes and DevOps tasks while improving Gartner’s self\-service capabilities using public cloud platforms and open\-source technologies.


Deliver world class availability, stability and performance of our digital products that guarantees a consistent and positive user experience for our customers  

  



**What you will do:**

* Deliver world\-class availability, stability, and performance for our digital products, ensuring a consistent and positive user experience for customers.
* Establish multi\-CDN architecture patterns, traffic\-steering strategies, failover mechanisms, and operational standards to achieve five\-nines (99\.999%) availability targets.
* Lead CDN incident response, disaster recovery exercises, capacity planning, and performance optimization initiatives to ensure uninterrupted customer experiences during internet\-scale events.
* Partner with Security, Infrastructure, and Application Development teams to implement and optimize edge security capabilities including DDoS protection, WAF policies, bot management, and edge compute services.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions to manage CDN configurations, governance policies, observability, WAF rules, and deployment processes.
* Design, build, and maintain global traffic management policies, including DNS routing, certificate management, and load balancing, to meet disaster recovery (DR) and high\-availability (HA) requirements.
* Design and implement edge\-computing solutions using Cloudflare Workers, Lambda@Edge, or equivalent technologies to address key application use cases.
* Define and monitor CDN\-specific SLOs, SLIs, and KPIs including cache hit ratio, origin offload, latency, availability, and traffic distribution across providers.
* Identify opportunities to improve the performance, scalability, and stability of applications across the full technology stack.
* Participate in operational support and on\-call rotations to provide timely incident response for supported systems and applications.
* Lead production incident resolution efforts, triage application and system issues, identify root causes, and implement remediation measures to restore services quickly.
* Develop alerting strategies, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to communicate operational and business critical metrics.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual operational work (i.e., “toil”) using pipelines, new software, or any other appropriate mechanisms.
* Drive system design consulting, platform management, capacity planning, and launch reviews. • Partner with application teams to design and implement chaos engineering practices that improve resilience and fault tolerance.
* Establish strong relationships with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to define and manage Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Manage, collaborate and share lessons learned regarding CDN architecture and deployments with all stakeholders, including developers, other SREs, operations teams, and project management teams.
* Improve customer experience and increase product value by enhancing the reliability, availability, and performance of client\-facing applications and service
* Internal relationships are critical to establish with application development teams and technology teams such as database, cloud/infrastructure, and enterprise architecture.

**What you will need:**

**Must Have**

* Expert knowledge of one or two enterprise CDN platforms, including Fastly, Cloudflare, CloudFront, Akamai, or equivalent technologies, with hands\-on experience designing, operating, and optimizing multi\-CDN environments.
* Experience implementing multi\-CDN routing and failover solutions using DNS, GSLB, traffic management platforms, or real\-user\-performance (RUM) driven traffic steering.
* Experience in managing large\-scale CDN platforms using Terraform/OpenTofu, CI/CD pipelines, or provider specific automation frameworks such as Fastly VCL, Cloudflare APIs or equivalent.
* Experience with CI/CD pipeline governance, code promotions, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code best practices to enable consistent, automated deployments across environments.
* Expertise in CDN observability, performance analytics, log analysis, and troubleshooting user experience issues across global regions and internet service providers.
* Strong understanding of edge security services including WAF, bot mitigation, DDoS protection, rate limiting, and zero\-trust access controls.
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills, coupled with strong verbal and written communication capabilities.
* Good To have:
* Demonstrated ability to adapt to changing priorities and technologies, with a strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
* Experience in collaborating with Development, Cloud and Architecture teams or other relevant teams to conduct RCA, drive mission critical initiatives
* Experience building Cloudflare Workers and snippets, AWS Lambda Edge functions, Fastly VCL, and Fastly Compute solutions.
* Experience with client\-side technologies such as NodeJS, JavaScript, React jQuery and utilizing CDN features to improve UI performance
* Hands\-on experience creating ACM certificates in Fastly, Cloudflare, or AWS.
* Exposure with monitoring tools like Splunk, Grafana and APM tools such as Dynatrace, or equivalent
* Proficient in Operating Systems (UNIX/Linux) \& networking concepts.
* Exposure to Performance \& chaos Engineering concepts

**Who you are :**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* 8\+ years of information technology experience with 6\+ years working on DevOps/SRE team or similar with focus on CDN.
* Knowledge of Agile approaches to software development and ability to put key Agile principles into practice to deliver solutions incrementally.
* Excellent analytical thinking, interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills with strong ability to influence both IT and business partners.
* Ability to prioritize and manage work to critical project timelines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated experience in people management, team leadership, and fostering a positive team culture.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.

This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.



Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

As Tech Lead for the Automation Team, you will play a pivotal role in Husky’s transition from legacy workflow platforms to a modern, scalable automation landscape centered on the Microsoft Power Platform. You’ll lead by example—guiding your team in designing, governing, and delivering Power Apps and Power Automate solutions—while also ensuring the reliability, continuity, and evolution of existing automation solutions such as K2\.



This role sits at the intersection of innovation and responsibility: driving modernization, setting technical standards, and mentoring engineers, while safeguarding the automation backbone that supports our global business operations.



If you enjoy combining hands\-on technical leadership, platform thinking, and pragmatic enterprise automation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

* Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post\-mortems

* Mentoring team members
* Documenting key design decisions
* Participate in interviews and hiring decisions
* Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement


**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams
* Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 10\+ years professional experience in software development, 5\+ years’ experience with Power Platform
* **Power Platform Expertise**
* Deep, hands\-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including: Power Apps (Canvas \& Model Driven)
* Power Automate (cloud flows, approvals, error handling)
* Dataverse (data modeling, security, performance)
* Proven ability to design enterprise\-scale Power Platform solutions
* Strong understanding of solution layering, Application Lifecycle Management, and environment strategies
* **Power Platform Governance**
* Hands\-on experience implementing Power Platform governance, including DLP policies, environment strategies, Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit
* Strong understanding of: Role\-based security in Dataverse
* Tenant\-level Power Platform administration
* Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments (e.g., GDPR, ISO, SOC)
* **Azure \& Microsoft Ecosystem**
* Solid experience in integrating Power Platform with Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Entra AD) and Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive)
* Experience with authentication and authorization: Entra AD, OAuth, service principals, managed identities
* **DevOps \& ALM**
* Proven experience with Power Platform ALM, including: Managed vs unmanaged solutions
* Versioning and deployment strategies
* **Experience with:**
* Azure DevOps or GitHub
* CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform
* Automated testing strategies (where applicable)
* Familiarity with source control best practices for low\-code assets
* **Development \& Customization Skills**
* Strong proficiency in: Power Fx
* JavaScript (for model\-driven apps)
* Understanding data modeling best practices and normalization
* Experience working with web services / APIs (e.g., SOAP, REST)
* Working knowledge of Agile development practices
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team
* Fluency in English (spoken and written)
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities


**Assets**


* K2 Five / K2 BlackPearl – Workflows, Smart Objects, Forms and Views, Administration \& Troubleshooting, End\-to\-End testing
* Certifications: PL 600 \- Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect Expert
* Experience setting up or running a Power Platform Center of Excellence
* Prior experience in citizen development enablement
* Exposure to AI Builder, Copilot Studio, or Power Platform \+ AI scenarios
* Background in enterprise integration


**Why Husky?**


**Regulated Working Hours:** Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work\-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well\-being.


**Visible Impact:** Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.


**Strategic Influence:** Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape.


**Empowered Involvement:** Take an active role in decision\-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy.


**Valued Contributions:** Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services.


**Impactful Role:** Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability.


**Cutting\-Edge Projects:** Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer’s business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements.


**Supportive Community:** Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members.


**Collaborative Environment:** Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success.

  

  



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. 2db683ef.description:
**li{ font\-size:** 14px;} p{ font\-size: 14px;}
  
Company Overview
  
  

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  

Job Overview
  
  

**Role Type:** Leadership / Professional ServicesMinimum Experience Required: 7–10 yearsLocation: Remote – United StatesBusiness Unit: ServiceNowDirect Reports: May include up to 5 employeesClient: Multiple ClientsHiring Manager: Michelle YoungReports To: Michelle Young
  
  

Role Summary
  
  

The Senior ServiceNow Engagement Manager is responsible for leading complex ServiceNow professional services engagements from initiation through successful completion. This role serves as the primary point of accountability for client relationships, project delivery, financial performance, resource coordination, and executive communication.
  
  

The ideal candidate combines strong ServiceNow delivery experience with excellent client leadership, financial management, and team development skills. This individual may also provide direct leadership and mentoring to other Engagement Managers.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Lead multiple concurrent ServiceNow implementation and transformation engagements.
  
  

Serve as the primary client contact and trusted advisor throughout the engagement.
  
  

Establish project governance, communication plans, delivery expectations, and escalation paths.
  
  

Manage project scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and deliverables.
  
  

Monitor project financials, including forecasting, utilization, invoicing, and budget variance.
  
  

Maintain accurate project records, status reports, financial data, and resource plans.
  
  

Partner with Sales and Solution Consulting to ensure effective sales\-to\-delivery handoffs.
  
  

Identify gaps in scope, assumptions, staffing, or client readiness before they affect delivery.
  
  

Facilitate executive steering committee meetings and communicate project health clearly.
  
  

Coordinate cross\-functional teams across onshore, nearshore, and offshore locations.
  
  

Manage scope changes and support the development of change orders when needed.
  
  

Anticipate delivery risks and lead timely resolution of client or project escalations.
  
  

Ensure projects follow organizational delivery standards and ServiceNow implementation practices.
  
  

Coach and mentor Engagement Managers and project team members.
  
  

Support continuous improvement across engagement management processes and governance.
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
  

7–10 years of experience in professional services, consulting, program management, or technology delivery.
  
  

5 or more years managing complex enterprise technology implementations.
  
  

Demonstrated experience delivering ServiceNow programs or projects.
  
  

Strong understanding of project financial management, including forecasting, budgets, margins, and invoicing.
  
  

Experience managing multiple projects and distributed delivery teams.
  
  

Proven ability to build strong relationships with client executives and senior stakeholders.
  
  

Experience managing project scope, risks, issues, dependencies, and change control.
  
  

Strong written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
  
  

Ability to lead through ambiguity and resolve complex delivery challenges.
  
  

Experience coaching or managing Engagement Managers, Project Managers, or similar delivery professionals.
  
  

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

ServiceNow implementation or consulting partner experience.
  
  

Experience with ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, SPM, CSM, HRSD, or related products.
  
  

PMP, PgMP, Scrum, SAFe, or comparable certification.
  
  

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or other ServiceNow certification.
  
  

Experience using ServiceNow SPM for project, resource, financial, and status management.
  
  

Experience working with enterprise clients across multiple industries.
  
  

Familiarity with hybrid Agile and ServiceNow Now Create delivery methodologies.
  
  

Success Measures
  
  

Projects delivered within approved scope, schedule, and budget.
  
  

Financial performance maintained within established variance targets.
  
  

Accurate and timely forecasting, invoicing, resource planning, and status reporting.
  
  

Strong client satisfaction and executive stakeholder confidence.
  
  

Risks and escalations identified early and managed effectively.
  
  

Engagement Managers and delivery teams receive consistent coaching and support.
  
  

Successful transition from sales to delivery and from implementation to ongoing support.
  
  

Compensation
  
  

**Estimated Pay Range:**  

Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.
  
  

Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion
  
  

At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.
  
  

Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.
  
  

We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self\-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.

7e2c89e9.title: AI Delivery Manager
7e2c89e9.description:
**About The Role**
 The AI Delivery Manager is a next\-generation leadership role responsible for transforming how engineering teams deliver software using AI\-powered systems, automation, and intelligent workflows. You’ll bridge Product and Engineering, design AI\-enabled delivery frameworks, and ensure teams ship faster and more predictably. This role is central to building AI\-powered delivery ecosystems — integrating MCP frameworks, AI agents, and automated governance into the software delivery lifecycle.
   

  

 Your scope includes bridging product requirements with engineering execution, building AI\-enabled delivery systems, conducting technical evaluation and architecture review, and owning delivery outcomes across programmes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Bridge product requirements with engineering execution
* Translate product requirements into clear, executable engineering deliverables.
* Evaluate technical feasibility and architectural implications of product requests.
* Ensure requirements are testable, traceable, and automation\-ready.
* Maintain traceability from requirements through development, testing, and deployment.
* Build AI\-enabled delivery systems
* Design and deploy AI\-powered delivery frameworks.
* Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) based systems.
* Architect and orchestrate multi\-agent AI workflows.
* Integrate AI governance, guardrails, and validation into CI/CD pipelines.
* Build reusable AI delivery accelerators and automation frameworks.
* Technical evaluation and architecture review
* Evaluate system architecture and engineering decisions across programmes.
* Assess AI frameworks, scalability risks, and vendor solutions.
* Review LLM implementations, vector databases, embeddings, and AI pipelines.
* Ensure governance, reliability, and security in AI systems.
* Delivery ownership and decision\-making
* Own delivery outcomes across programmes and use AI tools, metrics, and data insights to make decisions.
* Identify delivery risks early, resolve dependencies proactively, and improve delivery predictability, lead time, and release quality.
* Program and stakeholder leadership
* Drive alignment between Product, Engineering, and Leadership, providing technical clarity to senior stakeholders.
* Maintain visibility into delivery health and programme performance; ensure release readiness and governance compliance.


**Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of hands\-on technical experience as a Software Engineer, Tech Lead, DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, ML Engineer, or Solutions Architect.
* Strong programming experience in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, with hands\-on experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and a solid understanding of DevOps and MLOps practices.
* Experience building AI agent workflows and intelligent automation systems, with hands\-on exposure to LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar agent orchestration tools.
* Strong understanding of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG systems, and AI model evaluation and guardrails.
* Experience leading complex engineering or technical delivery initiatives, with strong command of Agile and flow\-based delivery methodologies.
* Proven ability to drive delivery improvements using data, metrics, and automation across cross functional teams.
* Strong ability to evaluate technical solutions, architecture, and implementation approaches; excellent stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
* Systems\-thinking mindset with a focus on building AI\-enabled delivery ecosystems.


**Required Skills**
* Hands\-on experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems in production.
* Track record of measurable improvements in lead time, release predictability, or escape\-rate defects.
* Experience building and operating AI governance and guardrails inside CI/CD.
* Background bridging Product and Engineering org\-design as well as delivery process.

3098858f.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
3098858f.description:
**Our Company**


At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.


**What You'll Do**


As a Staff Technical Program Manager at Teradata, you will drive delivery of significant, multi\-team technical programs across Teradata's product portfolio, owning execution from kickoff through launch while building strong relationships with engineering, product, and business partners.


* Own planning, execution, and delivery tracking for complex technical programs spanning multiple engineering teams and product areas.
* Build and maintain detailed program plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and milestone tracking dashboards.
* Facilitate cross\-team coordination and decision\-making to keep programs on track — running standups, program syncs, and steering reviews.
* Translate technical program status into crisp stakeholder updates for product leadership and senior engineering audiences.
* Identify and escalate delivery risks early; lead focused retrospectives to drive continuous process improvement.
* Coordinate launch readiness activities across engineering, QA, documentation, support, and go\-to\-market teams.
* Support data\-driven prioritization by maintaining program metrics and surfacing trade\-off analysis to product and engineering leadership.
* Apply foundational AI skills to explore and implement ways AI can enhance productivity, innovation, and impact across our workforce.

**WhoYou’ll Work With**


You will work as an embedded delivery partner within Teradata's Product organization, collaborating daily with:


* Product Managers and Principal TPMs to align delivery timelines with roadmap commitments.
* Engineering managers, tech leads, and QA teams across Vantage platform, cloud services, and analytics product areas.
* Design, Technical Writing, Support, and Marketing teams to coordinate end\-to\-end feature delivery and launch readiness.
* Finance and TA partners on program\-level resourcing and onboarding coordination for growing engineering teams.

Collaborate with colleagues who share a commitment to leveraging AI responsibly, ensuring our people and customers benefit from the opportunities AI creates.


**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**


* 6\+ years of technical program management experience, including at least 3 years in enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, or data analytics.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi\-team delivery programs involving engineering teams of 20 or more.
* Strong working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), data systems, or SaaS product delivery cycles.
* Hands\-on experience with Agile delivery methodologies, sprint planning, and program\-level tracking tools.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills — able to run effective meetings, surface issues clearly, and write crisp status reports.
* Foundational AI skills and the ability to understand how AI can be applied to improve outcomes in your area of expertise.

**What You'll Bring**


* Familiarity with data warehousing, SQL analytics, or cloud data infrastructure concepts.
* Experience coordinating programs that span US and international engineering teams (India experience a plus).
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar delivery management tools.
* Background in enterprise SaaS, B2B analytics, or open\-source data ecosystem delivery preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail — you keep complex programs tidy and stakeholders informed.
* Ability to build trust quickly with engineers and product managers; seen as a reliable execution partner rather than a process overhead.
* A passion for how AI can unlock potential to help our teams, our customers, and our communities achieve great things.

Role Summary



We are seeking a Presales Solution Architect with a strong Service Desk and Onsite Support delivery background to lead solutioning for managed Digital Workplace engagements.

The architect will design and articulate scalable operating models across:


* Global / Regional Service Desk (L1 / L1\.5 / L2\)
* Onsite and Field Support
* Digital Employee Experience (DEX) enablement
* Automation and containment strategies
* ITSM\-led orchestration
* Contact centre integrated support environments


The individual must be able to develop compelling solution documentation and executive\-grade presentations that clearly articulate value, feasibility, and differentiation.



Key Responsibilities



1\. Service Desk \& Onsite Support Solutioning


* Design end\-to\-end Service Desk and Onsite Support operating models.

* Conduct solution sizing including FTE modelling, skill pyramid design, shift planning, and span of control.
* Align workflows to ITIL v4 practices across Incident, Request, Knowledge, Major Incident, and Change interfaces.
